Functioneel applicatiebeheerder Backend Platform
jobs.description:
Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben? 

Wie ben jij

Je vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in applicaties en processen en neemt technische kennis mee. Wanneer een gebruiker met een vraag of probleem komt, wil jij niet alleen weten hoe je het oplost, maar ook begrijpen waar het vandaan komt.

Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen business en IT. Je kunt met een gebruiker praten over een bedrijfsproces en vervolgens met technische collega's of een leverancier bepalen wat er nodig is om een probleem op te lossen of een verbetering te realiseren.

Daarnaast kijk je verder dan je eigen applicatie. Je begrijpt dat systemen steeds meer met elkaar verbonden zijn en houdt daarom rekening met afhankelijkheden binnen de gehele keten.

 

We vinden het belangrijk dat je:

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur met een relevante opleiding;

  • ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer of een vergelijkbare functie;

  • affiniteit hebt met bedrijfsprocessen en informatiesystemen;

  • gebruikersvragen en problemen kunt analyseren en vertalen naar effectieve oplossingen;

  • ervaring hebt met het testen en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • oog hebt voor de samenhang tussen applicaties, processen en IT-ketens;

  • ervaring hebt met Agile werken;

  • initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en proactief handelt;

  • helder communiceert en gemakkelijk samenwerkt met gebruikers, IT-collega's en leveranciers.

 

Ervaring met applicaties of processen binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR is een pré. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan CODA, Crescendo, QIS of AFAS. Je hoeft ze zeker niet allemaal te kennen. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je ervaring hebt met applicatiebeheer en je nieuwe applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen snel eigen kunt maken.

Wat ga je doen

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij een belangrijke schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en leveranciers. Je zorgt ervoor dat applicaties en IT-diensten betrouwbaar functioneren en dat gebruikers goed worden ondersteund. Je werkt aan zowel de dagelijkse operatie als aan de verdere professionalisering van het beheer. Afhankelijk van jouw kennis, ervaring en de behoefte binnen Backend Platform kun je bijvoorbeeld werken aan applicaties binnen Finance, Verzekeringen of HR.


Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • functioneel beheren en ondersteunen van één of meerdere bedrijfskritische applicaties;

  • behandelen en analyseren van functionele vragen, incidenten en verstoringen;

  • bewaken van de goede werking en continuïteit van applicaties;

  • analyseren van gewenste wijzigingen en bepalen wat deze betekenen voor de applicatie en de omliggende keten;

  • afstemmen met gebruikers, leveranciers en IT-collega's over problemen, oplossingen en verbeteringen;

  • ondersteunen bij het realiseren en implementeren van wijzigingen;

  • voorbereiden, coördineren en uitvoeren van functionele en ketentesten;

  • bewaken dat wijzigingen correct en beheerst in gebruik worden genomen;

  • signaleren van mogelijkheden om processen, applicaties en het gebruik daarvan verder te verbeteren;

  • vastleggen en delen van kennis over applicaties, processen en werkwijzen.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht applicatiebeheer.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, eigenaarschap en vakinhoudelijke ontwikkeling.

  • Nauwe samenwerking met ervaren collega’s binnen IT, architectuur, security en waardestromen.

  • De mogelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van IT Kern.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

  • Jaarsalaris van € 51.777 tot € 71.907 bruto per jaar op basis van 38 uur, inclusief vakantiegeld en dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning;

  • Dienstverband van 32 tot 38 uur per week;

  • Standplaats Zwolle of Assen, met hybride werken in overleg met het team;

  • Een contract voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op een vast contract;

  • 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Variabele collectieve prestatiebeloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

  • 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

  • Goede pensioen- en studiekostenregeling;

  • Thuiswerk- en reiskostenvergoeding;

  • Korting op schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Binnen IT Kern werken verschillende teams aan het beheren, ondersteunen en doorontwikkelen van applicaties, platformen, infrastructuur, netwerkdiensten en securityoplossingen. Deze IT-diensten zijn essentieel voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening aan leden en voor de ondersteuning van onze collega’s. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. Je komt terecht in een team waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en plezier in het werk belangrijk zijn. We werken met collega’s die graag verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen om het applicatie- en IT-landschap iedere dag een stukje beter te maken.

Overige informatie

Enthousiast?

Vragen?

Bijzonderheden

Omdat we zoeken naar mensen die perfect bij ons passen houden we de werving en selectie graag in eigen hand. Wij maken daarom geen gebruik van diensten van uitzendbureaus en/of werving & selectiebureaus.

jobs.title: Senior Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities


Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

👉 Is deze functie perfect voor jou?

De werving en selectie voor deze vacature wordt verzorgd door bureau Staal Verbind. Reacties en sollicitaties graag via dit bureau. Ongevraagd aangeboden cv’s van andere bureaus worden niet in behandeling genomen.

jobs.title: Learning Design & Training Product Manager
jobs.description:
Location: Bracknell, UK (hybrid, 2 days per week in office) | Type: Full-time, 37.5 hour

Reports to: Head of Portfolio

The role in brief

Most learning designers build courses. In this role, you will own them.

As our Instructional Design & Training Products Manager, you will take a portfolio of professional training products from first idea to finished, quality-assured release, and keep them at their best for as long as they are in use. The training you build is used by aviation (civil and defence) professionals whose decisions keep people safe, so getting it right matters.

You will work alongside some of the most respected subject matter experts in aviation safety, helping them turn deep technical knowledge into learning that is clear, engaging and works in the classroom, online and in blended formats. You will have real influence over how we design, develop and quality-assure our training, including how we use AI to do it better.

If you have a background in learning design or training product development, a sharp eye for quality, and want to see your work make a visible difference, we would like to hear from you.

Why this role matters

This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.

Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.

What you will do

  • Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

  • Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

  • Lead learning design with SMEs: turn expert knowledge into clear learning objectives, specifications, storyboards and design documentation.

  • Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

  • Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

  • Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

  • Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

  • Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.


What you will bring

  • At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

  • A track record of designing professional training materials for classroom, virtual or blended delivery.

  • A solid grounding in learning design principles (for example ADDIE) and in training needs and gap analysis.

  • A strong eye for quality and detail – you notice what others miss, from a weak learning objective to an inconsistent heading.

  • Strong project management skills, and the ability to juggle several products, deadlines and stakeholders at once.

  • Confidence working with subject matter experts: asking the right questions, challenging constructively, and turning expertise into effective learning.

  • Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat.

  • Excellent written English, to publication standard.

Nice to have

  • Experience in aviation, defence or another safety-critical or regulated industry.

  • E-learning or blended learning development experience.

  • A recognised L&D or instructional design qualification.

  • An understanding of IP and contract frameworks.

  • Experience using AI in content development.

What success looks like

  • 90% or more of product milestones delivered on time.

  • 100% of releases meet QA, brand and IP standards.

  • A 40% reduction in SME effort on repeatable development tasks.

  • Fewer maintenance requests and releases each year.

  • AI used effectively across the development process.

  • Positive feedback from stakeholders and learners on usability and quality.

Join Baines Simmons

Baines Simmons builds the competence behind aerospace and defence safety. For 25 years we have delivered expert, approachable training and consulting to civil and military aviation organisations worldwide: more than 750 organisations served, over 200,000 professionals trained, and 40 or more regulatory authorities advised.

We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Across every sector, and alongside global regulators, we help organisations continuously improve safety, airworthiness and compliance. We go beyond helping them comply with regulations; we empower them to excel in operational and safety performance.

We look for curiosity, passion, leadership and impact. Our people do not just advise on safety. They change how clients manage it. If you want your work to make a measurable difference to aviation safety, we would like to hear from you.

One organisation, four brands

Baines Simmons is one of four TrustFlight brands. TrustFlight is the Aerospace Safety Intelligence Platform, building the technology that helps aviation operate safely and stay compliant. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. Together we share one platform, one set of values and one purpose: closing the gaps between disconnected tools and providers, because those gaps are where risk accumulates. Working at Baines Simmons means your expertise connects to all four.

Why people stay

We believe people do their best work when they have the freedom to do their job without too many rules and barriers getting in the way. Our culture is built on empowerment and trust: we hire good people and expect them to make the right calls for the customer, company, and themselves. Transforming an industry means our people have to keep learning. We earn our clients' confidence by being honest and dependable with each other, and that includes caring about the important things in life outside of work.

Our offices in the UK, Canada, the US and Jersey are where teams meet to collaborate and plan. People who deliver earn more say in how their career develops, from the path they take to the flexibility they need.

If you want to make a real difference to safety, this is the place to be.

How we work with AI

TrustFlight is an AI-first organisation, and we provide AI training where it is appropriate for your role. In this role that means using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Copilot and Gamma) to draft and structure content, accelerate documentation and reports, and support knowledge management, while critically reviewing and refining every AI-generated output for accuracy, clarity and professional quality. You will design and apply AI-enabled workflows that make product development faster and more consistent, look for new places to integrate AI into our processes, and share what works with the team. You will complete our AI fluency onboarding within your first 30 days and spend four hours a month experimenting with AI tools and building your skills.

Where and how you will work

  • Working hours: 37.5 hours per week, core hours 09:00–17:00

  • Work pattern: Hybrid, 2 days per week in our Bracknell office

  • Travel: Occasional travel as required

  • On-call or shift work: None

  • Screening or clearance: Criminal record check required

What we offer

  • Competitive salary of £38,000 to £44,000

  • Generous holiday allowance

  • Company pension contribution

  • Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical

  • Support for personal career development

  • Flexible working arranged with your manager

Ready to apply?

Send us your CV. We would also love a short cover letter telling us about a training product you designed and are proud of: what the need was, how you approached it, and what difference it made.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - CIMAR
jobs.description:
Company Overview  

CIMAR UK Ltd, now a part of DeepHealth, is a leading provider in the SaaS (Software-as-a-Service) healthcare sector, specialising in advanced cloud-based image management solutions. Our technology empowers healthcare organisations to optimise image management processes, enhance patient care, and streamline workflows through seamless integration and actionable data insights.

Job Summary 

The DevOps Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within the Platform Engineering team, responsible for supporting and evolving DeepHealth's AWS-based infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD tooling, and operational processes. Working closely with the Senior Platform Engineer, this role focuses on infrastructure automation, cloud operations, platform reliability, and continuous improvement. The DevOps Engineer plays an important part in helping development teams deliver software efficiently while ensuring that DeepHealth's infrastructure remains secure, scalable, and resilient.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities: 

·       Design, build, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tooling (Terraform or equivalent), ensuring consistency, repeatability, and version control.

·       Manage and improve Kubernetes platforms (EKS or similar), including cluster configuration, scaling, upgrades, and reliability.

·       Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable software delivery across development teams.

·       Monitor platform health and performance, respond to incidents, and drive root cause analysis and resolution to maintain high availability.

·       Automate operational processes and repetitive tasks to reduce toil and improve team efficiency.

·       Implement and maintain cloud security best practices including IAM policies, network security, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.

·       Support development teams with platform tooling, onboarding to infrastructure services, and resolving environment-level issues.

·       Manage container image pipelines and registry, including security scanning and lifecycle management.

·       Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of infrastructure, processes, runbooks, and architectural decisions.

·       Contribute to cost monitoring and optimisation across cloud services, identifying inefficiencies and recommending improvements.

 

 

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above.  Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience: 

·       Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).

·       5+ years of experience in a DevOps, platform engineering, or cloud infrastructure role (required).

·       Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC, and related) (required).

·       Experience managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments (required).

·       Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or equivalent (required).

·       Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform (required).

·       Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or similar for automation (required).

·       Solid understanding of networking fundamentals including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and VPNs (required).

·       Security-conscious approach to infrastructure design and operations (required).

·       Preferred: Experience with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar).

·       Preferred: Familiarity with GitOps practices and tooling (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux).

·       Preferred: AWS certification (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Solutions Architect).

·       Preferred: Experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare or finance.

 

Quality Standards  

• Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

• Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

• Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

• Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

• Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

• Practices universal safety precautions.

• Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

• Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

• Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

• Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Physical Demands 

This position often requires sitting, standing, walking, bending, twisting, reaching with hands and arms, using hands and fingers, handling, or feeling, speaking, listening, and high-level cognitive thinking. Also, must be able to lift up to 10 pounds occasionally.

Travel 

This position may require occasional travel.

Working Environment 

Remote

“The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Salary

£60,000 - £70,000 per year

jobs.title: Senior Client Partner (Public Sector)
jobs.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Client Partner to join our Public Sector New Business Team for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from any of our UK offices (Dundee, Glasgow, Edinburgh and London)  2 days a week 

Are you a collaborative leader who excels at building meaningful relationships and shaping transformative digital solutions in the Public Sector? As our Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in growing our Public Sector practice, acting as a trusted advisor to senior public sector stakeholders. You will work closely with our cross-functional teams to foster strategic partnerships, inspire creative proposals, and drive intelligent digital transformation that delivers real public value

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Creating Demand & Nurturing Relationships: Find, qualify, and develop opportunities with prospects and clients. Build and maintain trusted, peer-level relationships from delivery teams through to executive stakeholders.

  • Pitching & Proposals: Inspire and lead collaborative, cross-functional teams to win new business. Uncover client needs, articulate compelling win themes, and co-create high-impact proposals.

  • Planning & Pipeline Management: Develop systematic Account and Go-To-Market plans. Accurately forecast pipeline growth, extensions, and revenue alongside colleagues in delivery and finance.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Partner with tech, strategy, and delivery leaders to estimate and shape balanced commercial proposals. Negotiate long-term, win-win contracts that bring genuine value to both Waracle and our public sector partners.

  • Adding Strategic Value: Stay ahead of Public Sector and technology trends to bring valuable insights to clients, enhancing Waracle’s reputation as expert thought partners.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box


What you'll bring

  • Proven track record of nurturing relationships and securing impactful work within central government departments or enterprise clients.

  • Strong relational skills, with an empathetic and collaborative approach to negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management in complex organisations.

  • Sound commercial stewardship and written/verbal communication skills, with comfort presenting ideas to executive and board-level audiences.

  • Strong understanding of Waracle's services, digital technology trends, and the Public Sector landscape.

  • Deep experience navigating public sector procurement frameworks (e.g., DOS6/7, GCloud 14/15, Tech Services 3/4, Public Contracts Scotland, Public Tender Scotland).

  • High level of integrity, empathy, and resilience, alongside enthusiasm for continuous learning and innovation.

  • Prior experience within the civil service or as a civil servant is welcomed, though not required.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

  • 3. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. This will be a practical presentation.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen.

Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt.

Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd.

  • Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging.

  • Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen.

  • Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken.

  • Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen.

  • Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd.

Daarnaast:

  • heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment;

  • werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties;

  • werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team;

  • kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen;

  • heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré;

  • beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift.


Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
jobs.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🧲 Our Talent Team

At Joko, hiring has been a founding obsession since day one. Our founders have always been convinced that markets aren't cracked with headcount — they're cracked with talent density. That bet has worked: we've grown to 6 million users and become one of France's most recognized shopping apps with just 30 people in the early years, and we've kept the same bar as we've scaled past 100.

The Talent team exists because we believe talent is the single biggest asset of a company, and that identifying, attracting, and closing the best profiles is a craft worth investing in seriously. We are constantly experimenting with state-of-the-art techniques, tools, and processes to find the people who will build the future of shopping with us.

Today, the Talent team sits within the broader People function, which also covers People Ops, People Business Partnering, and Workplace across France, Spain, and our growing international footprint into the US. We are a team with a big scope and rare ownership per person, and we move fast.

✨ Why this role is special

Recruiting is Joko's #1 company objective — because talent unlocks everything else — which makes this one of the most strategic seats in the company. Three things make it genuinely rare:

  • The team is exceptionally involved in hiring. From ICs to managers to founders, recruiting is treated as a first-class responsibility, not something delegated to TA. You will work with hiring partners who actually show up, give sharp feedback, and care about the bar as much as you do.

  • You will have the tools, and the budget, to be on the frontier. We already work with a modern stack (Ashby, Claude, Claap, and more), and we keep investing to stay among the most performant and modern TA setups out there. You will not be fighting for basic tooling, you will be deciding what comes next.

  • You will live a genuinely unique scale moment. Growing from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, with a real international component (France, Spain, US, and more to come) is the kind of stretch many TA leaders don’t often get to experience. You get to do it here, with a company that has already proven it can build a recognized product with a fraction of the usual headcount.

To be concrete about what this looks like in practice: in year one, the job is to build the team — sourcing, hiring, and coaching the TAMs who will power Joko's growth. The AI strategy, international employer brand, and long-term function design are the horizon you are building toward. They are real, and you will own them fully. But the foundation comes first, and the foundation is the team.

🎯 What you will do

As Head of Talent Acquisition, your mission is to build and lead the TA function that will take Joko from 100+ people today to 200+ within 18 months, and beyond, with the bar, craft, and intentionality that have defined Joko's talent density since day one. You will report to the VP People and be part of the People leadership team, alongside the Head of People Operations and our Lead People Business Partner. You will partner closely with founders, hiring managers, and the broader People team.

  • Build and own the TA team: The most important thing you will do, especially early on, is hire the recruiters who will hire everyone else. Two Talent Acquisition Managers are already in the team, and four more TAM positions are open today. You will make the case for what else the function needs over time, from sourcing specialization onward, and recruit, coach, and grow the team around you.

  • Define how Joko recruits: Inbound, outbound, RPO management, agency relationships, tooling (Ashby), and process are all yours. You will set the standards, not just execute against them — including upskilling hiring managers so the bar is applied consistently across every panel.

  • Recruit senior and critical roles yourself: You will stay close to the hardest hires. You know when to delegate and when to own the desk.

  • Build a global AI strategy for recruiting: The way recruiting is done is changing drastically with AI. You will define and roll out Joko's AI strategy for TA: which parts of the funnel to automate, which tools to deploy, how to keep human judgment where it matters most, and how to turn AI into a real competitive advantage in how we source, screen, and close. You will own this end to end.

  • Drive an international employer brand: We are not well known enough yet, and that is costing us. You will build an employer brand strategy that reflects who we actually are, starting in France, scaling very soon to Spain, and preparing for the US and other markets.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have stood up a TA function before, or rebuilt one, and you have also worked somewhere with best-in-class standards. You can operate in both 0-to-1 mode and best-in-class mode, and you know when to switch. The strongest candidate may not have done "just" Talent — a track record that spans ops, sales, consulting, or building things beyond recruiting is a real asset here.

  • Coaching mindset: You know how to develop the resourcefulness and drive of the people you manage. You see growing recruiters as part of the job, not a tax on it.

  • High-bar mindset: Joko's culture is built on talent density. Our hiring managers are involved, exacting, and not afraid to pass on a 90% candidate. You find that energizing, not frustrating.

  • Ops-oriented and performance-driven: You think in systems, not one-offs. You instrument the funnel, care about the numbers, and build process that holds up as the team scales.

  • Strong sense of craft in TA: You know the difference between a recruiter who has relied on inbound for years and one who genuinely knows how to source. You’ve done both, and you know which approach each situation calls for.

  • Analytical skills: You reason with data — funnel metrics, conversion rates, capacity plans — and you use it to drive decisions, not to decorate slides.

  • Attention to detail: You know candidates judge us on every touchpoint — an outreach message, a scorecard, an offer letter — and you hold the bar on all of them.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You take ownership without being asked, you welcome feedback, and you go the extra mile by default.

  • Curious and experimental about AI: You don't claim to have it all figured out, the field moves too fast for that. But you have hands-on experience deploying AI tools into a TA function, you have strong opinions formed from real attempts (and real failures), and you genuinely enjoy figuring out what works.

  • International scope: Paris, Barcelona, New York, our footprint is growing. You are comfortable recruiting across geographies and building an Employee Value Proposition that resonates in more than one market.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Education: No specific requirement. Track record matters more than credentials.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language). Spanish is a plus.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

jobs.description:
The Role

Geordie is building the platform enterprises rely on to govern their AI agents safely — and we're growing fast. We're looking for a technical, customer-focused Technical Account Manager to own the post-sale relationship with our customers and make sure they get the best from their Geordie deployment, fast.

You'll be the technical face of Geordie for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — guiding onboarding and integration, becoming the go-to expert customers trust for anything technical, and working closely with our sales, product and engineering teams to keep our customers successful and growing. You will turn technical relationships into lasting partnerships.

This is a hands-on, technical role. You'll get deep into our platform, our customers' environments, and everything in between — and you'll help shape how Geordie delivers success for our customers as our first UK-based TAM hire.

We also expect you to work the way we build — intelligently and efficiently. That means embracing AI agents in your day-to-day workflows. We use tools like Claude Cowork to move faster and do more. If you're not passionate about that, this probably isn't the right place for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own the Technical Relationship — Be the primary technical point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building trust from customer kick-off through renewal and expansion.

  • Project Management — Own the project plan for onboarding and major implementations end-to-end: timelines, milestones, resourcing, and risk tracking across customer, engineering, and product stakeholders. Run the cadence of standups/status calls, keep everyone accountable to dates, and escalate slippage before it becomes a surprise.

  • Onboarding & Implementation — Guide customers through deployment, integrations, and configuration, so they see value from day one.

  • Product Mastery — Become a deep expert on the Geordie platform. Troubleshoot issues, answer technical questions, and give customers confidence in how we work.

  • Adoption & Health — Track account health and usage, spot risks early, and drive the actions that keep customers engaged and expanding.

  • Escalation Management — Be the calm, capable owner of technical escalations — coordinating with engineering and product teams to resolve issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Renewals & Expansion — Partner with our sales team to identify expansion opportunities and ensure strong technical health underpins every renewal opportunity.

  • Customer Advocacy — Bring field insights back to our teams — feature requests, friction points, and what's actually happening in customer environments — so we keep building the right things and ensure the customer remains at the centre of everything we do.

  • Documentation & Enablement — Build the runbooks, guides, and best-practice materials that make onboarding repeatable and support scalable.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Work closely with sales, engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.

  • Build the Function — As our first UK TAM, help shape the processes and playbooks that define how Geordie supports customers as we scale, in step with the wider TAM function.

What We're Looking For

  • You're technical, and you like it. You're comfortable in the details — agents, APIs, integrations, security, governance — and you enjoy figuring out how things really work.

  • You own outcomes. You don't wait — you track account health and get ahead of risk before it becomes a churn conversation.

  • You're a builder. Early-stage means you create structure where there isn't any and find a way to provide value to customers.

  • You're AI-fluent, not just AI-aware. You use tools like Claude Cowork and other agentic AI to run your own workflow — drafting runbooks, triaging tickets, prepping QBRs, chasing account health signals — so you spend your time on judgement calls and relationships, not repetitive admin. You look for the next task to hand off to an agent before you look for the next hire.

  • You earn trust at every level. You can debug an integration issue with an engineer in the morning and brief a CISO on progress in the afternoon, without losing credibility in either room.

  • You listen before you troubleshoot. You ask sharp questions to understand what's actually going on before you propose a fix, then deliver.

  • You communicate clearly and often. Customers always know where things stand.

  • You're focused on success. Not just at renewal time — all the time. You care whether customers succeed, and it shows in how you show up.

  • You embrace new ways of working. You actively use AI tools — especially agents — to work smarter, move faster, and do more. You thrive in ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 2–5 years' experience in a Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer role at a SaaS or cybersecurity company.

  • Passion and interest in agents, how organisations are utilising them, their security and risk, and their governance.

  • Solid technical fluency — comfortable with agent architectures, agent security, agent tooling, APIs, SaaS/cloud integrations, and cloud environments.

  • Proven track record of owning post-sale relationships with enterprise customers, including onboarding, adoption, and renewal.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues, including coordinating with engineering teams on fixes.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work confidently with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong discovery and problem-solving skills — able to get to the root of a customer issue quickly.

  • Comfortable delivering polished, tailored product walkthroughs and training sessions independently.

  • Highly organised, with rigorous attention to detail across documentation, account health tracking, and follow-through.

  • Collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

  • Based in the United Kingdom, with the right to work in the UK, and the flexibility to travel to customer sites as needed.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting security, AI/ML, or agentic tooling customers.

  • Active experience creating, deploying and managing agents.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth Series A–B SaaS company.

  • Light scripting or coding ability (e.g. Python) and comfort working with API tools such as Postman.

  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS, Azure, or equivalent).

Why This Role

AI agents are changing how enterprises operate — and the question of how to govern them safely is becoming mission-critical. Geordie is the platform companies are turning to for that answer. As one of our first Technical Account Managers, you won't just be running a playbook — you'll be writing it. You'll have real influence over how we onboard, support, and grow our customers, and a direct line to Product on what to build next. If you want to go deep on a hard technical problem and build something that matters, this is it.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection — testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

sA Platform for Your Best Work

We want this to be the most meaningful chapter of your career. Geordie is the place where you grow, lead and lift others, while building something that truly matters.

This role will sit at the intersection of mechanical design, optics, and manufacturing, helping us translate optical designs into robust, manufacturable hardware.

You will take ownership of designing and validating opto-mechanical assemblies, including mounts, and alignment structures for optical and photonic components. You will work closely with Hardware, and manufacturing engineering teams as well as vendors from across the world to ensure designs are optically sound, mechanically robust, and ready for scalable production.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role suited to someone comfortable moving between CAD design, optical modelling, and physical prototyping and testing. What you'll be doing

  • Design opto-mechanical components and assemblies (mounts, housings, brackets, alignment stages) using SolidWorks

  • Model and analyse optical systems and tolerances using Zemax

  • Translate optical design requirements into manufacturable mechanical designs

  • Perform tolerance analysis to ensure optical alignment and performance across manufacturing variation

  • Build and test prototypes to validate opto-mechanical designs against optical performance targets

  • Support fibre-to-chip and free-space alignment integration for photonic assemblies

  • Work closely with manufacturing team and vendors to ensure designs are suitable for production and assembly

  • Investigate and resolve mechanical or thermal issues affecting optical performance (e.g. misalignment, drift, stress-induced effects)

  • Solid understanding of optics fundamentals (alignment, tolerances, beam propagation, focusing)

  • Some industrial, internship, or substantial project experience in opto-mechanical, mechanical, or optical engineering

  • Ability to perform tolerance stack-up analysis for optical and mechanical systems

  • Comfortable working hands-on in laboratory and prototyping environments (hands-on lab /manufacturing experience)

  • Strong troubleshooting mindset with a practical, iterative approach to engineering

  • Ability to communicate clearly with cross-functional engineering teams

  • Able to travel to vendor sites to transfer knowledge and troubleshoot problems.

Even better if you have

  • Experience with photonic or semiconductor packaging and assembly

  • Familiarity with fibre alignment, free-space optics, or laser-based systems

  • Experience with thermal or structural analysis (FEA) as it relates to optical performance

  • Exposure to manufacturing or production environments

  • Familiarity with material selection for optical and thermal stability

We are open to candidates from Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical disciplines. Fresh graduates with strong relevant experience through projects, internships, or research are encouraged to apply.

This is an opportunity to work on genuinely challenging problems across optics, mechanics, and manufacturing, with direct influence on how advanced AI hardware is designed and built.

jobs.title: Senior long-term oil analyst
jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role
 

As a Senior Long-Term Oil Analyst, you will own Kpler’s strategic multi-decade outlook for crude oil, refined products, and alternative liquid fuels within the evolving global energy system. Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways. 


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead long-term market research and scenario modeling: Spearhead Kpler's multi-decade (5 to 25+ year) research coverage and fundamental supply, demand, and trade scenarios for crude oil, refined products, NGLs, and low-carbon fuels.
  • Analyze structural market drivers and transition pathways: Deliver in-depth research on upstream capital investment, OPEC+ and non-OPEC capacity shifts, refinery configuration trends, transport electrification, and evolving environmental policies.
  • Anchor macro projections in granular trade flows: Leverage Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level tracking to translate multi-decade macro perspectives into actionable implications for regional balances, trade routes, refining margins, and midstream infrastructure.
  • Author authoritative research publications: Produce regular, high-impact outlook publications, strategic research notes, and thematic market commentary under Kpler’s Insights banner, clearly framing key assumptions and structural uncertainties.
  • Synthesize cross-commodity dynamics: Collaborate with Kpler’s Gas, LNG, and Power research analysts to ensure cohesive, system-wide market assumptions, while benchmarking models against international agencies such as the IEA, EIA, and OPEC.
  • Serve as a trusted market authority: Represent Kpler’s research in executive client briefings, commercial advisory sessions, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements.

    • Experience & Background

    Essential:

  • 5+ years of prior experience in energy market analysis, energy modelling or strategy, with a focus on oil and liquids markets 
  • Proven experience building and maintaining supply and demand or scenario models, including a good understanding of the drivers of long-term outlooks
  • Strong understanding of the oil and refined products value chain and of energy transition dynamics
  • Experience in producing independent market analysis and insights
  • Skilled at conducting complex analyses across multiple datasets using advanced data analytics tools
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

    • Desirable:

  • Knowledge of gas, LNG, power or low-carbon fuels and how they interact with liquids markets
  • Previous experience using Kpler data or other cargo tracking tools
  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data science tools
    • We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?
     
    We make things happen
    We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
     
    We build together
    We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
     
    We are here to help
    We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
     
     
    Our People Pledge
     
    Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.

jobs.title: Cdi - Responsable Chef De Produit Chaine Et Trame Femme (H/F)
jobs.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).

VOTRE RÔLE 

Le/la Responsable Chef de produit Chaîne & Trame Femme est en charge du développement des catégories C&T, Denim et Cuir. Il/Elle est en lien avec la direction créative et assure le développement des collections dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais.

Le poste combine une forte implication opérationnelle sur le développement produit ainsi que le management de 2 chefs de produit et d’une alternante.

VOS MISSIONS 

  • Produit : piloter le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme (incl. denim et cuir) du brief à la normalisation. Assurer la mise au point des produits (du 1er prototype au SMS) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et la cohérence produit. Sécuriser la faisabilité industrielle tout en proposant des ajustements adaptés.
  • Coûts : contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations si nécessaire.
  • Suivi & coordination : piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien avec les différents intervenants (studio, tissus et fournitures, merchandising, atelier et production), et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des différents jalons de développement.
  • Management : encadrer 3 ressources, organiser les priorités, accompagner le suivi des développements et garantir la bonne tenue du périmètre.

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Solide expérience en développement chaîne & trame femme, incluant denim et cuir.
  • Excellente compréhension des process industriels, de la mise au point produit et des exigences qualité.
  • Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément dans un environnement créatif et exigeant.
  • Rigueur, sens du détail, autonomie et forte capacité d’adaptation.
  • Aisance dans la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes.
  • Première expérience réussie en encadrement ou forte appétence pour le management.

Le poste est basé dans le 8ème arrondissement de Paris.

C'est quoi l'équipe Produit Poker ?

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
