jobs.title: Product Owner Revolving Doors
jobs.description: Are you ready to bring your innovative perspective and creative skills to ASAA ABLOY Business Segment Pedestrian (BSP) within the ASSA ABLOY Entrance Systems? Join our team in Landskrona, Sweden and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of. What would you do as our Product Owner Revolving Doors. As Product Owner for our Revolving Door product range, you assume full technical ownership of a comprehensive and established product line. Coordinating a multidisciplinary R&D team spanning hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineering, you will set priorities, drive alignment with portfolio priorities, and create the conditions in which engineers can perform and grow at their best. This position is well suited to a technically grounded person who combines hands-on engineering insight with the ability to coach a team, manage complexity, and drive results with discipline and clarity.The role reports to Head of Security Entrance Control and Revolving Doors, and works closely with senior stakeholders across product management, manufacturing, quality, and global ASSA ABLOY divisions to drive innovation, performance, and long-term business impact. You would also:     Oversee and develop a multidisciplinary R&D team — provide clear direction and hands-on management of hardware, firmware, and mechanical engineers; foster a culture of technical excellence, structured problem-solving, and continuous professional development, while coaching the team toward stronger resolution-making and greater ownership.    Own the full product development lifecycle — drive concept, validation, industrialisation, and ongoing lifecycle improvements, while ensuring consistent adherence to applicable safety and quality standards, including ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL.    Define and execute the R&D strategy — establish the product roadmap, ensure alignment with broader portfolio and business targets, manage R&D resources, budgets, and timelines, and embed sustainability principles across all stages of product development.    Drive innovation and the adoption of emerging technologies — identify opportunities to enhance product performance and design, stimulate creative thinking within the team, and evaluate the application of IoT, connectivity, AI, and other forward-looking technologies across the product range.    Represent the product externally and manage key stakeholder relationships — act as a credible technical ambassador in customer meetings, trade shows, and industry forums, while maintaining strong internal alignment with segment management, commercial product managers, and factory teams. The skills and experience you need We are looking for someone who has:     Engineering foundation — a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or a related field, combined with a solid background in R&D for electromechanical products gained through hands-on engineering, product development, or early-career coordination roles.    Product lifecycle expertise — demonstrated experience managing the full development lifecycle, from concept and validation through to industrialisation and continuous improvement, with a strong understanding of systems, spare parts, and lifecycle stewardship.    Technical guidance skills— proven ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, with the capacity to set direction, manage priorities, and drive delivery across hardware, firmware, and mechanical disciplines.    Compliance and quality awareness — familiarity with relevant safety and quality standards such as ISO, CE, EN16005, and UL, and a structured approach to process optimisation and regulatory adherence.    Domain knowledge and technology acumen — familiarity with revolving doors, door mechanics, drive systems, sensors, or embedded control units is a strong advantage. We equally welcome candidates who bring technical curiosity, analytical strength, and the motivation to grow into a product ownership role. An interest in emerging technologies such as IoT, connectivity, and AI is highly valued. You are a natural leader who guides with clarity and purpose — someone who inspires confidence in a team not through authority alone, but through genuine engagement, consistent follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves when it matters. You think in possibilities, approaching technical tasks with creativity and a structured mind, always looking for smarter ways forward. You are customer-centric by nature, with a keen sense of how engineering decisions translate into real-world impact — both for end users and for the business. You balance technical depth with pragmatic judgement, knowing when to dive into the details and when to step back and see the bigger picture. Proficiency in spoken and written English and Swedish is essential. Additional languages are a welcome advantage. Above all, you act with integrity. You take ownership of your work and your team's outcomes, bring a safety-conscious mindset to every resolution, and hold yourself accountable to the highest standards — commercially, technically, and as a supervisor of people. What we offer We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:     Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills    A competitive salary and incentive schemes We review applications regularly, so don’t wait We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Mona Yusefi Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at mona.yusefi@assaabloy.com. Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subjected to a background screening. The performance of the background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice. Let’s create a safer and more open world - together! To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com

jobs.title: Software Engineer (C++)
jobs.description:
Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto’s technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.The roleYou will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto’s software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform—from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.What you will do
  • Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
  • Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
  • Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
  • Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
  • Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
  • Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
  • Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
  • Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
  • Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
  • Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms..
What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
  • You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
  • You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.
What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.
  • Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
  • Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
  • Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
  • Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
  • Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
  • Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
  • Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.
Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.Who you areBeyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:
  • Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Take ownership and follow things through.
  • Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
  • Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
  • Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
  • Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.
Why join Robotto?Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:
  • Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
  • Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
  • Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
  • See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
  • Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.
Our hiring processWe want our hiring process to be straightforward, transparent and conversational.1. Introductory conversation with People & CultureA chance for us to learn more about you and for you to learn more about Robotto, the role and what we are looking for.2. Meeting with the Hiring ManagerA deeper conversation about your experience, skills and approach to the role.3. Technical / Role-specific discussionDepending on the position, this may include a technical discussion, practical exercise, case or live scenario relevant to the work you would be doing at Robotto.4. Leadership meetingA conversation with a member of our leadership team to explore mutual fit and give you another opportunity to learn about Robotto and where we are going.5. OfferIf there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.The exact process may vary slightly depending on the role.Interested?If this sounds like an opportunity you would like to explore, we would love to hear from you.Apply through our careers page and tell us a little about yourself, your experience and why Robotto interests you.Equal opportunityAt Robotto, we want to build a team where different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or other characteristics protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Embedded Software & Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy writing C++ software that interacts directly with hardware and makes complex systems perform reliably in the real world?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our work brings together computer vision, embedded software, control, electronics and real-world product development.We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer with strong C++ experience to develop software close to the hardware layer of our drone platform. Experience with motor control and Field-Oriented Control (FOC) is highly preferred.This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of software, electronics and control systems, where performance, reliability and real-world behaviour matter.The roleYou will work on embedded software that supports the control and operation of Robotto’s drone and unmanned systems.Your work will involve developing reliable C++ software that interfaces with hardware, sensors, motors and other system components. You will work closely with colleagues across control, electronics, computer vision and flight testing to take software from development through integration and into real-world operation.For candidates with motor-control experience, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of our motor-control capabilities, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC).What you will do
  • Develop and maintain embedded software in C++ for drones and unmanned systems.
  • Build software that interfaces with motors, sensors, actuators and other hardware components.
  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive software.
  • Contribute to motor-control software, including Field-Oriented Control (FOC), where relevant to your experience.
  • Develop and integrate communication between embedded components and wider product systems.
  • Debug complex software and hardware interactions and identify root causes of issues.
  • Collaborate closely with control, electronics, flight-test and software engineers.
  • Contribute to software architecture, testing, documentation, code quality and technical decisions.
  • Support integration and testing on real hardware and drone platforms.
What success could look like in your first 3–6 months
  • You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto’s embedded architecture, hardware and control systems.
  • You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our embedded platform.
  • You are successfully integrating and debugging software on real hardware.
  • You are contributing to improved reliability and performance across our embedded systems.
  • If you have motor-control experience, you are actively contributing to our FOC and motor-control development.
  • You have become a trusted technical partner for colleagues across software, control, electronics and flight testing.
What we are looking forWe are looking for an engineer who is comfortable working close to hardware and enjoys solving complex technical problems where software and physical systems meet.
  • At least 3 years of professional software engineering experience, ideally within embedded or real-time systems.
  • Experience with motor control, particularly Field-Oriented Control (FOC), is highly preferred. Experience with BLDC/PMSM motors, control loops, PWM, encoders or related motor-control technologies would also be highly relevant.
  • Strong C++ programming skills.
  • Hands-on experience developing software that interfaces with hardware.
  • Experience with embedded systems, real-time systems, microcontrollers or similar low-level environments.
  • Good understanding of debugging, testing, software architecture and version control.
  • Experience with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C or similar is an advantage.
  • Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems or other complex electromechanical products is an advantage.
  • Professional fluency in English.
  • A degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, mechatronics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.
Who you areYou are practical, curious and comfortable getting close to both the software and the hardware when solving a problem.
  • You take ownership of your work and care about software quality and reliability.
  • You enjoy understanding how systems behave beyond the code itself.
  • You approach debugging methodically and are comfortable solving difficult software/hardware problems.
  • You collaborate well across software, electronics and control disciplines.
  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities.
  • You communicate technical trade-offs, progress and risks clearly and pragmatically.
Minds and makers forging ahead together.At Robotto, we value people who do. People who take ownership, are willing to try new things just to see if they work, and are comfortable asking for forgiveness rather than permission. We want people who are curious, proactive and excited about turning ideas into something real.Our hiring processOur process is designed to be straightforward, practical and conversational:1. Introductory conversation with our Talent Acquisition & Recruitment PartnerA chance to learn more about Robotto, the role and what you are looking for, while giving us an opportunity to understand your background and motivation.2. Meeting with the Hiring Manager / Principal EngineerA deeper conversation about your technical background, C++ and embedded experience, motor-control experience where relevant, and your approach to solving engineering problems.3. In-depth Technical Evaluation & Meeting with our COOA hands-on technical session where you will receive a short assignment to prepare in advance and then work through it together with members of our technical team, similar to a pair-programming exercise. The focus is on understanding your technical approach, problem-solving and how you collaborate.Following the technical evaluation, you will meet with our COO for a conversation about the role, Robotto and mutual fit.4. OfferIf there is a strong mutual fit, we will move forward with an offer.Why join Robotto?Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, control and real-world operations.You will join a highly technical and ambitious team at an exciting point in the company’s journey. As we continue to scale our engineering team and work on challenging new projects, you will have the opportunity to influence how our embedded and control software develops.This is a role where your software will not remain behind a screen. You will see it integrated with real hardware, tested on real systems and used in demanding real-world environments.You will work closely with talented engineers, take meaningful technical ownership and help shape the next generation of Robotto’s technology.Equal Employment OpportunityRobotto is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience and potential. Please note that certain positions may require specific nationality or eligibility for security clearance in accordance with applicable laws and the nature of our work.

jobs.title: BPA assistent ønskes i Moss
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Jeg søker en humørfylt og engasjert personlig assistent som vil være med å gi meg fleksibilitet i hverdagen. Jeg lever et aktivt og selvstendig liv der jeg liker å være ute i nærmiljøet og delta på sosiale aktiviteter. Som min assistent blir du mitt praktiske verktøy i hverdagen.

Jeg er blind og har førerhund, så det er helt avgjørende at du trives godt med dyr. Stillingen innebærer ingen tunge løft eller pleie/stell.

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Praktisk bistand i hverdagen og i nærmiljøet

  • Bli med på sosiale aktiviteter og turer

  • Husarbeid og enkel matlaging

  • Kjøring ved behov (du må ha førerkort klasse B)

Stillingsstørrelse og arbeidstid:

  • Fast deltid på 5 timer per uke, med mulighet for ekstra vakter ved behov.

  • Dag-, kveld- og helgevakter som planlegges ut fra mine aktiviteter.

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ingen spesiell fag bakgrunn, da opplæring vil bli gitt. Det viktigste er hvem du er som person. Jeg ser etter deg som er:

  • Initiativrik, kreativ og ser løsninger

  • Fleksibel, pålitelig og har godt humør

  • Omgjengelig og trygg på deg selv

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Du er over 18 år

  • Du har gode kommunikasjons evner på norsk

  • Du har førerkort klasse B

  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse (innhentes i forbindelse med tilbud om jobb)

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering - Learning Ecosystem
jobs.description:
PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering – Systems Engineering Learning Ecosystem: competencies for systems engineering, AI and business innovation

Do you want to contribute to the development of knowledge, insight and solutions that are relevant to society and working life today and in the future?

We are looking for a PhD research fellow within Systems Engineering.

About the position

Do you want to shape how Norwegian industry learns systems engineering, AI and innovation? Join us as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Science and Industry Systems, campus Kongsberg. Start: May 2027 (at the latest August 2027).

You will be part of SFI CELECT – the Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems – whose vision is to do more with less, and faster. The centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, brings together Norway's leading industrial companies and 30 PhD candidates across USN, NTNU and the University of Agder. You will also join the Industrial Research School in Complex Systems (INRESCOS).

The position is a three-year educational position with pure organised research training. A four-year appointment with 25 % career-advancing work may be considered.

You must apply for and be admitted to the doctoral programme in Technology (Systems Engineering) within three months after starting in the position. The programme includes courses of about six months (30 ECTS), an independent thesis, research dissemination, a trial lecture and a public defence.

Your workplace will be campus Kongsberg. You will work closely with several CELECT partner companies through interviews, surveys and workshops.

Campus Kongsberg sits at the heart of one of Norway's strongest technology clusters, with world-leading companies in maritime, defence, aerospace, energy and subsea technology. Research and industry work side by side – giving you a unique network and strong career opportunities in industry or academia.

About the doctoral project

The aim of this PhD is to develop and validate a competency framework for systems engineering, AI and business innovation and translate it into work-integrated learning for Norwegian industry.

Companies lack an overview of which competencies their engineers need and how to build them while they keep working.

In this PhD you will evolve the frameworkin collaboration with industry. Questions you could explore:

• What competency gaps exist in Norwegian industry today?

• Which learning formats actually work for engineers in full-time jobs?

• How can universities and companies co-develop learning that lasts?

You will help shape the final research questions in cooperation with your supervisors and industry partners.

The project is part of SFI CELECT (project PhD5.1), and a workpackage headed by Gerrit Muller. You will run surveys, workshops and pilot courses with CELECT partners such as Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, TechnipFMC, Siemens Energy, Nammo, Knightec Group, Hive and Herøya Industripark, together with NTNU, UiA and INRESCOS – and your results will feed directly into training at least 200 engineers.

This position is one of several related CELECT PhD positions at USN: it focuses on competence and learning, and complements positions on early design and validation (PhD1.3), life-cycle management of long-living systems (PhD1.4) and early systems integration in systems-of-systems (PhD1.5).

 

Duties

  • Complete the doctoral programme up to completion of the doctoral degree within the employment period
  • Conduct high-calibre research within the framework described above
  • Academic publications in high-quality journals and participate conferences
  • Work closely with several partner companies through interviews, surveys and workshops, combining qualitative and quantitative research
  • Co-design, pilot and evaluate learning modules and micro-credentials together with CELECT partners
  • Report progress and deliver outputs to the CELECT centre
  • Participate in the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE)
  • Active involvement in SFI CELECT's doctoral team across NTNU, USN and UiA, including the research school INRESCOS and participation in common workshops, learning events and courses
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign research and educational institutions
  • Be prepared for changes in your work tasks after appointment

 

Qualifications

All items are requirements, unless it is specified that they are preferred qualifications.  

  • Master's degree (120 ECTS credits) within Systems Engineering, an engineering discipline, industrial economics and technology management, computer science, or a closely related field
  • Documented knowledge of relevant methodologies, both quantitative and/or qualitative, at master's level
  • Weighted average grade of B or higher on the master's degree and thesis
  • The master’s thesis must have been submitted for assessment by the application deadline for the position and approved before starting in the position
  • Knowledge of systems engineering and/or business model innovation is preferred
  • Knowledge of competency frameworks, engineering education, workplace learning or learning analytics is preferred
  • Understanding of AI in engineering is preferred
  • Industrial experience from Norwegian industry and or teaching, is preferred
  • Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2, is preferred
  • Excellent written and oral English language skills
  • Meet the formal requirements for admission to USN's doctoral programmes and the Faculty of Technology, Natural Sciences and Maritime Sciences' doctoral programme in Technology, with the topic of Systems Engineering, no later than three months after starting in the position

 

Personal qualities

In order to be able to complete a doctoral degree, you need to be able to:

  • demonstrate motivation and potential for research in the field
  • work independently, but also participate in teamwork
  •  work in a structured way, set goals, and make plans to achieve them
  •  present and discuss your research with other academics
  • get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity
  • show curiosity and strong motivation for the subject area
  • analyse data, assess different perspectives, and draw well-founded conclusions
  • work collaboratively in an industrial setting with the CELECT partners
  • be flexible and open to adjusting the project plan as necessary
  • have the academic skills and personal qualities to be able to complete the doctoral programme within the employment period

 

When assessing applications, particular importance will be attached to 

  • Formal qualifications
  • The personal qualities mentioned above
  • Motivation letter
  • Work experience from Norwegian industry
  • Qualifications and experience in systems engineering, competence development and/or engineering education/teaching
Requirements for proficiency in English 

This position requires good English language skills. International applicants must document this with a valid certificate from one of the following tests. Specific requirements regarding grades can be found on our webpage English requirement for programmes and subjects taught in English at USN.

  • TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT)
  • IELTS – International English Language Testing Service 
  • Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) from the University of Cambridge
  • PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic

The following applicants are exempt from the requirements listed above:

  • Applicants with one year of completed university studies in Australia, Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, UK or USA
  • Applicants who have completed a master’s degree with English as the language of instruction in an EU or EEA country
  • Applicants who are exempt based on the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir)’s GSU list (Higher Education Entrance Qualification for foreign applicants)

Applicants from Norway can confirm their English language skills by submitting their upper secondary school diploma.

Requirements for proficiency in Norwegian

The position has no formal requirement for proficiency in Norwegian. Proficiency in a Scandinavian language, or Norwegian at level B2 (language levels as defined by HK-dir), is preferred.

Applicants who wish this to be taken into account must document their language skills in the application (see How to apply).

Requirements regarding a licence and/or security clearance

The applicant must meet the requirements for authorization for restricted. You can read more about security clearance on the websites of the National Security Authority and the Civil Clearance Authority. For the position, an export licence is also required, and the applicant must meet the requirements for this. You can read more about export licences on DEKSA's website.

Motivation letter

Applicants must submit a motivation letter with the application. This should be short and concise, maximum 500 words.

The final project description and work plan will be prepared in consultation with the supervisor(s) during the first three months of the employment period. It is a prerequisite that you complete the project during the employment period.

What we offer
  • Organised research training in a large undertaking with an important social mission
  • Careers advice and guidance throughout the entire doctoral programme. Together we will draw up a career plan that includes the skills and knowledge you will acquire
  • An inclusive working environment with ambitious colleagues
  • The opportunity to take Norwegian language courses
  • Salary in accordance with the Norwegian State salary scale for PhD research fellows (position code 1017) NOK 550,800. In special cases, code 1378 may be used. Any further increases in pay grade will be based on length of service in the position
  • Deductions will be made from your salary in order to make statutory contributions to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund on your behalf
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund, ensuring favourable pension, insurance and loan schemes
Diversity

We believe that diversity is a resource in our work and learning environment. Different experiences and backgrounds contribute to different perspectives and better solutions to challenges that need to be solved.

We are committed to respecting each other's differences and will facilitate employees with disabilities. We take into account your needs and your situation in different phases of life.

If you find this position interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, disability, cultural background or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

If there are qualified applicants with disabilities, gaps in their CV or an immigrant background, we will call at least one applicant in each of these groups for an interview. If you recognize yourself in one of these categories, you can tick the box in our job search portal.

The university aims to recruit more women to PhD positions within the field. If multiple applicants are considered to have equivalent qualifications, a woman will be given priority over a man.

General information

The Appointment Committee for Fellowship Positions (TUS) is the appointing authority for this position. Your competence for the position will be assessed by an expert committee. The expert committee will assess your competence for the position based on the documentation you have registered in Jobbnorge. 

Based on the expert committee’s assessment, relevant applicants will be invited to an interview and to hold a trial lecture. References will also be obtained for relevant candidates. 

Employment at USN is carried out in accordance with the principles set out in the Norwegian Civil Service Act, and the legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services. If your application is considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter legislation, it will be rejected without further consideration.

The University's Guidelines for Recruitment Positions provide a more detailed description of the criteria for appointment as a PhD research fellow.

As an employee of USN, you must at all times adapt to changes in the field and all organisational changes that are adopted.

How to apply

If you think this position looks interesting and matches your qualifications, you can submit an application electronically by clicking on “Apply for the position” on this page. Here you will need to enter a short application text and information about your relevant education and work experience. In the application text, you must clearly describe your skills and motivation for the position. 

The application must include:

  • Certified diplomas for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees (120 ECTS). The diplomas must be in a Scandinavian language or English
    • Applicants with higher education completed outside Norway must provide documentation that the education has been recognised and approved by the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) You must submit your application for approval before the position’s application deadline. Attach a receipt or decision when applying. The approval must be forwarded once available and is a requirement for employment.
  • An explanation of the grading system for foreign education (diploma supplement if available)
  • Other relevant certificates and diplomas
  • A motivation letter containing a personal statement explaining your motivation for the position, maximum 500 words
  • Documentation of your Scandinavian/Norwegian language skills (if relevant, see Requirements for proficiency in Norwegian)
    • Language proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish can be documented in the following ways:
      • a high school diploma
      • a diploma from higher education completed in a Scandinavian language
      • a passed language test that documents Norwegian skills at the B2 level, for example the “Norskprøve for innvandrere” or a level 3 Norwegian course at a higher education institution
  • Documentation of your English language skills (see Requirements for proficiency in English above)
  • List of any scholarly publications
  • Contact information for up to three references
  • A copy of your passport (required for export licence / security clearance)

The application will be assessed based on the information available in Jobbnorge at the expiry of the application deadline. Make sure your application shows clearly how your skills and experience meet the competence requirements described in the job advertisement. 

When assessing who is best qualified for the position, we attach weight to education, experience and personal qualities. 

All documentation must be provided in a Scandinavian language or English. If the attachments exceed 30 MB in total, they must be compressed before uploading.

Please note that information about you as an applicant may be disclosed publicly even if you have requested not to be included on the public list of applicants (cf. Section 25 of the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act).  You will be notified if your request for exemption from public disclosure is denied.

We only consider applications and attachments registered in Jobbnorge. On request, you must be able to provide certified copies of your documentation.

Contact information

For more information about the position, please contact:

Head of Department Professor Aida Omerovic, aida.omerovic@usn.no, +47 35 95 26 53 

Professor Kristin Falk, kristin.falk@usn.no, +47 97 58 69 09

Professor Satyanarayana (Satya) Kokkula, satyanarayana.kokkula@usn.no, +47 31 00 88 13

 

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact:

Advisor Tonje Holt Vøllestad, tonje.h.vollestad@usn.no

About us

The University of Southeastern Norway (USN) ranks as the country's fourth largest higher education institution. We are a vibrant community of approximately 18,000 students and 1,900 employees.

About the Faculty and Department

Department of Science and Industry Systems – University of South-Eastern Norway: 

Institutt for realfag og industrisystemer - Universitetet i Sørøst-Norge 

Video: https://vimeo.com/898549899/60305e2540

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At USN you’ll contribute to a mission that matters. The University of Southeastern Norway was established in 2018, following the merger of several smaller university colleges, some with historical roots dating back to the 17th and 18th centuries. We are committed to collaborative problem-solving, aiming to provide solutions that benefit our communities – locally as well as globally.  Our diverse campuses are located from the beautiful fjords to the snow-covered mountains. USN spans three Norwegian counties, with campuses in Bø, Drammen, Horten, Kongsberg, Notodden, Porsgrunn, Ringerike, and Rauland.  Wherever you’re located, you will engage in meaningful work amidst a thriving student culture and innovative research environments. Our university offers a wide range of high-quality and internationally recognized academic programs.With a strong emphasis on profession-oriented and socially relevant education, we prepare our students for the workforce and equip them with the necessary skills to make a positive impact on society. At USN, we deeply value and cultivate our relationships with local communities. Our staff and students are actively engaged in a variety of projects that address societal challenges, driving change and innovation. We place a strong emphasis on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity, and we strive to shape future leaders, innovators, and change-makers. jobs.title: Vil du ha en annerledes og meningsfull jobb i et hjem fylt med humor, varme og hverdagsglede?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne i starten av 40-årene som søker trygge og pålitelige BPA-assistenter til å bidra til at hverdagen min fungerer godt.

Jeg bor sammen med samboeren min, to barn, en hund og to katter i et rolig og hyggelig hjem med mye latter, varme og en uformell tone. For oss er det viktig at hjemmet føles trygt og godt, både for familien og for deg som assistent.

Jeg bruker rullestol og har språkvansker, og trenger derfor praktisk bistand i hverdagen. Samtidig er jeg først og fremst en engasjert mamma som liker å være aktiv og finne på ting med familien. Jeg trives ute på tur, liker å ha det hyggelig rundt meg og setter stor pris på blomster, interiør og et hjem der det er godt å være.

De som kjenner meg beskriver meg som ei positiv dame med godt humør og glimt i øyet. Kjemi betyr mye for meg, og jeg håper å finne assistenter som er rolige, fleksible og lette å være sammen med.

Hos meg blir du ikke bare en assistent – du blir en viktig del av hverdagen vår.

Om stillingen:

Jeg søker både faste assistenter og tilkallingsvikarer. Det er en fordel om du kan jobbe 3. hver helg ved fast ansettelse.

Arbeidstid vil kunne være:

·       dag

·       kveld

·       helg

·       ferier

Stillingsstørrelse avtales nærmere.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

·       Personlig stell og daglige gjøremål

·       Hjelp med forflytning

·       Bistand til trening, logopedi og fysioterapi, du vil få god opplæring

·       Praktisk bistand i hjemmet

·       Følge til avtaler ved behov

·       Kjøre HC bil

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ikke erfaring fra helse eller BPA – god opplæring vil bli gitt. Det viktigste er at du er:

·       pålitelig og ansvarsfull

·       rolig og trygg

·       løsningsorientert og lærevillig

·       komfortabel med å jobbe selvstendig

Det er en fordel om du er vant til barn, er fleksibel og trives med å finne praktiske løsninger i hverdagen.

Du må:

·       ha førerkort klasse B

·       være komfortabel med å kjøre større bil

·       tåle hund og katt

Det er også viktig at du har godt humør og bidrar til en hyggelig hverdag. Personlig egnethet og kjemi vil bli vektlagt høyt. Grunnet arbeidets art oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Jeg tilbyr:

·       En trygg og meningsfull jobb

·       God opplæring

·       Et hyggelig og uformelt arbeidsmiljø

·       Varierte arbeidsdager

·       Mulighet for faste vakter

Dessuten ansettes du i Prima Assistanse som har tarifflønn, ansattfordeler, solid timeføringsprogram og ordnede forhold. Hos Prima Assistanse vil du få en egen kontaktperson, kurs og opplæring som trygger deg i rollen som assistent.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Senior SAP Integration Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind itesys, DEIN synonym für Engineering Excellence.

Wir sind über 200 Technikexpert:innen mit einer gemeinsamen Leidenschaft für SAP-Technologie, SAP Security und Platform Engineering – und das seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2012. Wir sehen uns als kreative Köpfe und strategische Wegbereiter:innen, als Umsetzer:innen und Optimierer:innen, immer mit einer gehörigen Portion Spirit und Begeisterung. Genau diese Mischung macht uns aus!

Wir kennen die digitalen Herausforderungen unserer Kundschaft und liefern die passenden Lösungen. Dank unseres tiefen Fachwissens und unserem ausgeprägten technischem Weitblick gelingt es uns, die IT-Landschaften unserer Kunden kontinuierlich an die komplexen und sich ständig verändernden Anforderungen anzupassen.

Mit deinem Wissen…

  • konzeptionieren, implementieren, realisieren und betreiben wir komplexe System- und berätst du unsere Kunden umfassend und weitsichtig mit einem hohen Servicegedanken

  • betreust du eigenständig bestehende SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Landschaften und entwickelst diese mit internen und externen Schnittstellen weiter

  • planst, organisierst und setzt du technische Projekte im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld um

  • leitest du die Implementierung und den Rollout von Schnittstellen in Kundensystemen, einschliesslich der Migration von SAP PI/PO auf die SAP Integration Suite

  • führst du Performance Analysen durch und berätst unsere Kunden bei Architekturfragen und deren technischer Formulierung, auch im Hinblick auf die strategische Weiterentwicklung Richtung SAP Integration Suite

Das gelingt dir durch...

  • Berufserfahrung im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld und mehrere erfolgreich realisierte Projekte in diesen Bereichen

  • sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares)

  • fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich SAP Software Architektur sowie Erfahrungen mit Integrationstechnologien wie z.B. Webservices/XML/SOAP/REST/OData

  • eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten

  • Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder?

Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten:

Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell: Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen.

Weiterbildung: Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem

Zukunftsorientierung: Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft.

jobs.title: Blomsterbinder/-Dekoratør/Florist
jobs.description:
Er du træt af butik åbningstider med weekend arbejde, som blomsterbinder/blomsterdekotatør hos os arbejde du indenfor normale kontortider mandag til fredag.

Vi søger 1 ny kollega til vores team af florister.

Så vil du med på vores spændende rejse, hvor du arbejder fra vores nye flotte binderi i Søften ved Aarhus. 

God timeløn og du bestemmer selv dine arbejdstider, også hvis du ønsker forskellig timetal uge for uge. 

Samtidig binder vi i letter materialer, så du ikke belaster dine skulder og arme så meget. 

Vi går meget op i et godt arbejdsmiljø, så du står på absoberende måtter, har hæve/sænke arbejdsbord, og du får arbejdestøj og det bedste i værktøj.  

Vores indeklima er ikke vådt og fugtigt som du kender det fra trationelle blomsterbutikker. 

Jobbet går ud på at binde bæredygtige blomsterbuketter, som vi sælger på vores webshop og via design, indretning, brugskunst og møbelbutikker. Vi sælger i både Danmark, Sverige, Norge og Tyskland.

I vores koncept køre vi med flere forskellig buketter design i 3 størrelser. Det er disse buketter man skal binde, man arbejder i vores binderi og står sammen med søde kollegaer.

Tjek vores hjemmeside www.livingflowers.dk for lidt mere info om vores bæredygtige koncept og for at se vores buketter.

Udover buketter levere vi også mere og mere til Hoteller og restauranter, hvor vi laver speciel designs, som tilpasses kundes behov. Så ønsker du yderlig udfordring, så er der muligheder hos disse kunder. 

Det er et krav at du er blomsterbinder, blomsterdekoratør uddandelsen eller minimum har arbejdet fuldtid i nogle år som blomsterbinder.  

Vi læser ansøgningerne løbende når de kommer ind og indkalder også løbende til samtaler, så sende endlig din ansøgning med det samme.

 

ENGLISH VERSION: 

We are looking for full-time florist, we are very flexible with come and go times, we will find the best working hours for you. As we are not a store, we do not work in the weekends. 

We are located in Søften (Aarhus), and the job is to tie sustainable flower bouquets, which we sell on our webshop and via shops around Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Germany.

See more about us at : www.livingflowers.dk

It is a requirement to have a florist education or have worked with binding flowers full time for minimum 3 years.

jobs.title: Erfaren og engageret lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator søges til Børn og Unge, Aarhus Universitetshospital
jobs.description:
Leder du efter en ny unik spændende stilling så er her muligheden Erfaren og engageret lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator søges til Børn og Unge, Aarhus Universitetshospital  

Børn og Unge søger lægesekretær/sundhedsadministrativ koordinator til fast stilling pr. 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter.  Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid, men der er mulighed for deltid.  

Om afdelingen Børn og Unge er en afdeling på Aarhus Universitetshospital, der behandler børn og unge i alderen 0-17 år. Vi er samtidigt en af landets største børn- og ungeafdelinger med 71 senge, 6.500 indlæggelser og mere end 25.000 ambulante besøg årligt. Børn og Unge omfatter 15 pædiatriske fagområder, hvor en eller flere højtspecialiserede funktioner varetages inden for hvert fagområde. Vi er en afdeling med mange snitflader og samarbejdspartnere. Vores ambition er inden for en årrække at etablere et Børn og Unge Hospital på Aarhus Universitetshospital. Dette strategiske og visionære arbejde er påbegyndt. 

Om stillingen Stillingen er som primært knyttet til hormon sygdomme. Som specialesekretær vil du få en central rolle i at sikre en effektiv og struktureret arbejdsdag med de patientadministrative opgaver i et spændende speciale, hvor du vil være en central holdspiller sammen med dine tværfaglige kollegaer i forhold til at løse opgaverne med de bedste patientforløb for øje samt præge opgaveudviklingen.

Om sekretærteamet Lægesekretærerne i Børn og Unge er organiseret i to drift-teams, hvor du vil blive tilknyttet Team 1. Teamet dækker over 8 fagområder. I hvert fagområde er placeret 1-3 sekretærer, der varetager det enkelte fagområdes administrative opgaver. Fagområdesekretærerne varetager den daglige arbejdstilrettelæggelse i samarbejde med teamet.  Vi tilpasser løbende vores organisering.  

Arbejdstiden skal som hovedregel placeres mellem kl. 07.00 og 17.00. Du har her stor medbestemmelse. Der er desuden mulighed for op til to hjemmearbejdsdage om ugen efter aftale.

I arbejdstiden fordeler vagter sig i løbet af normperioden på 19 uger til cirka 6 hverdags-senvagter (senvagter slutter kl. 18:00) samt 1 lørdags- og 1 søndagsvagt (kl. 08:00-14:00). Antallet af vagter kan variere i ferieperioder eller under vakancer. Det er muligt at arbejde hjemmefra i vagterne.  

Vi lægger stor vægt på fleksibilitet og på at skabe en hverdag, hvor vi trives og udvikler os sammen.  Vi vægter og praktiserer høj grad af frihed under ansvar i vores arbejde.

Vi har selvfølgelig fokus på kompetenceudvikling og du vil have mulighed for efter-/ videreuddannelse under hensyntagen til den daglige drift. 

Du får 

  • en grundig, tæt og tryg oplæring med tæt sparring
  • en spændende og varieret hverdag med høj faglig kompleksitet
  • indsigt i flere spændende fagområder 
  • godt arbejdsmiljø hvor du er en del af et stærkt både mono- og tværfagligt team  

Arbejdsopgaver

  • koordinering, booking og overblik over patientforløb
  • håndtering af visitation og indkald af patienter efter retningslinjer og patientrettigheder
  • arbejde med kvalitetslister, optimering af DRG samt data
  • telefonbetjening og opfølgning
  • skrivning og registrering
  • ad hoc-opgaver

Vi søger en ny kollega som 

  • er uddannet SAK/lægesekretær og har erfaring med sundhedsadministrative opgaver  
  • har gode samarbejdsevner
  • har selvstændighed, er struktureret og trives med ansvar i tværfagligt samarbejde
  • har lyst til og mod på at bidrage til udvikling 
  • bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø med hjælpsomhed, humor og nysgerrighed
  • er visionær, flair for eller nysgerrig på den digitale udvikling vores fag står overfor og har mod på ansvar for nye spændende opgaver indenfor udvikling som f.eks. PAS-, UBR-, RPA-, BOM- eller brev-kontaktperson

Kontakt 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen og evt. aftale et besøg, er du velkommen til at kontakte sundhedsadministrativ leder Jane Lund Møller, tlf. 3071 5411.  

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 48.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Ansættelsen er betinget af tilfredsstillende børneattest. 

For yderligere oplysninger om Børn og Unge, Aarhus Universitetshospital, klik her 

 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Teknisk Isolatør Danmark (m/k/d) - Technical Insulator Denmark (m/f/d) - Technischer Isolierer Dänemark (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
See desription in English below

Siehe Beschreibung auf Deutsch unten

Dansk:

TL Concept er en veletableret produktions- og entreprenørvirksomhed, der er specialiseret i teknisk isolering, pladekapper, ventilationskanaler og brandbeskyttelse. Med mange års erfaring og ca. 600 dygtige medarbejdere, leverer vi løsninger af høj tysk kvalitet til byggeprojekter i hele Europa. TL Concept oplever stærk vækst, og Danmark er et af vores strategiske vækstområder. Vi har etableret et dansk selskab med dansk ledelse. www.tlconcept.eu      

 

Vi er kendt for vores fokus på innovation, præcision og en kundecentreret tilgang. Vores mål er at skabe bæredygtige og effektive løsninger, der lever op til vores kunders krav om kvalitet, samtidig med at vi sikrer et sikkert og inspirerende arbejdsmiljø for vores medarbejdere. Hos TL Concept er vi stolte af vores stærke teamkultur, hvor samarbejde og udvikling er i centrum. Vi tror på, at motiverede medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater, og derfor prioriterer vi uddannelse og personlig udvikling.

 

Vi søger en engageret Teknisk Isolatør til vores team. Hos os får du mulighed for at lære at arbejde med alle typer teknisk isolering og udvikle dig indenfor området, da vi ikke kun isolerer, men også monterer ventilationskanaler og pladekapper.

 

Som Teknisk Isolatør vil du være medansvarlig for at drive vores projekter fremad. Du vil  være en del af et team på op til 15 isolatører, og din arbejdsdag vil være præget af variation og ansvar. Mulighed for forfremmelse, hvis du gør det godt og beviser dit værd.

VI TILBYDER

·  Et ansvarsfuldt og afvekslende job i en dynamisk virksomhed med vindermentalitet

·  Ansættelse efter dansk lov i dansk datterselskab

·  Fastansættelse på 37 timer/uge

·  Mulighed for faglig udvikling og eventuel videreuddannelse

·  Ægte holdånd, åben kommunikation og uformel arbejdsatmosfære

·  Professionelle processer og korte beslutningsveje

·  Timeløn efter kvalifikationer og gode ansættelsesvilkår iht. Isoleringsoverenskomsten

·  Betaling for evt. overarbejde

 

FAGLIGE OG PERSONLIGE FORUDSÆTNINGER

·  Praktisk og håndværksorienteret og har erfaring med montering af teknisk isolering

·  God fysik og kan arbejde selvstændigt samt i team

·  Ansvarlig og kvalitetsbevidst , loyal, ærlig og vindende personlighed

·  Indstillet på at lære og tage ansvar for egne opgaver

·  Mødestabil og kan stå op om morgenen

·  Villig til at rejse til aktuelle byggeprojekter i Danmark (vi har aktuelt projekter på Sjælland 1 år frem)

·  Taler min. et af følgende sprog: Dansk, norsk, svensk, polsk, engelsk eller tysk

·  Arbejdstilladelse i EU samt kørekort (kategori B)

 

DINE OPGAVER

·  Montering af teknisk isolering af ventilationskanaler, kedler, tanke, rør og diverse andre tekniske installationer

·  Montering af pladekapper og ventilationskanaler

·  Brandsikring af beton- og stålkonstruktioner samt rørgennemføringer

·  Arbejde med både nye installationer og vedligeholdelse af eksisterende anlæg

Send dit fyldestgørende ansøgningsmateriale på dansk engelsk eller tysk per e-mail, inklusive cv, lønforventning og tilgængelighed, til Jørgen Villadsen: jorgen.villadsen@tlconcept.eu

 

For spørgsmål er du velkommen til at kontakte Jørgen per e-mail.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English:

TL Concept is a well-established manufacturing and contracting company specialising in technical insulation, sheet metal cladding, ventilation ducts and fire protection. With many years of experience and approx. 600 skilled employees, we deliver solutions of high German quality to construction projects throughout Europe. TL Concept is experiencing strong growth, and Denmark is one of our strategic growth areas. We have established a Danish company with Danish management. www.tlconcept.eu We are known for our focus on innovation, precision and a customer-centric approach. Uanset om du har afsluttet din uddannelse, holder sabbatår eller blot er klar til nye udfordringer, kan stillingen være et godt næste skridt.

Som telefonsælger hos Vivo Sales kontakter du privatpersoner og rådgiver om a-kasse, fagforening og lønsikring.

Du får grundig oplæring i både produkter, salg og samtaleteknik, så du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet. Derfor er tidligere salgserfaring ikke et krav. 

Om Vivo Sales

Vivo Sales arbejder med mødebooking og direkte salg og har afdelinger i Vejle, Silkeborg og Aarhus. Vi er omkring 50 medarbejdere på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os går faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø hånd i hånd. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere trives, udvikler deres kompetencer og samtidig bliver en del af et socialt fællesskab.

  • Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for salg og kommunikation

  • Et socialt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger,

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Mulighed for at opbygge værdifuld erfaring med salg, kundedialog og behovsafdækning

  • Sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter, der styrker fællesskabet på tværs af lokationer.

  • Små faste traditioner i hverdagen, blandt andet juice hver torsdag

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Trives med at tale med mange forskellige mennesker

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Er engageret og møder på arbejde med en positiv indstilling

  • Motiveres af at arbejde med salg og resultater

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og stemningen på arbejdspladsen

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, hvad der allerede står på dit CV, men at du har motivationen til at lære og blive dygtig til jobbet.

Arbejdssted: Toldbodgade 8, st. 8000 Aarhus CArbejdstid: FuldtidAnsøgning: Via ansøgningslinket på siden

jobs.title: Vi søker BPA-koordinator
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om en meningsfull jobb der du får gjøre en forskjell i andres liv hver eneste dag? 

Da kan dette være stillingen for deg. Vi trenger flere inn i teamet vårt, og ser etter vår nye koordinator. Som BPA-koordinator hos Abri Dialogue får du ansvar for din egen kundeportefølje og blir en viktig støtte for arbeidsledere og assistenter i hverdagen. Rollen passer godt for deg som liker å jobbe med mennesker, samtidig som du trives med struktur, koordinering og å finne gode løsninger på små og store utfordringer.

Vi ser etter deg som er trygg i møte med ulike mennesker, kommuniserer godt og evner å skape tillit. Du trives med ansvar, liker å ha mange kontaktflater og motiveres av å bidra til at mennesker lykkes i arbeid og hverdagsliv. En stor del av jobben handler om rekruttering av assistenter, der målet er å finne mennesker som passer godt sammen. Derfor trenger vi deg som evner å se andre menneskers behov og styrker, og som kan bistå med stillingsutlysninger og intervjuprosesser. Det er en fordel om du har førerkort og disponerer egen bil. 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være: 

  • Oppfølging og ansvar for egne arbeidsledere (vedtakseier/brukere)
  • Råd, opplæring og veiledning til arbeidsledere og assistenter 
  • Bidra til gode samarbeidsforhold mellom arbeidsledere, assistenter og samarbeidspartnere
  • Administrative oppgaver knyttet til BPA-ordninger, slik som blant annet onboarding og offboarding i systemer
  • Rapportering til oppdragsgivere
  • Delaktig i HMS-arbeid
  • Rekruttering 
  • Tilrettelegging av kurs og fellessamlinger 
  • Markedsføring av Abri Dialogue i regionen, ansvar for planlegging og gjennomføring av markedsaktiviteter

Arbeidstiden er hovedsakelig på dagtid, men noe kvelds- og helgearbeid må påregnes. 

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • Er menneskeorientert, pedagogisk og trygg i veilederrollen 
  • Er åpen, tar initiativ og er løsningsorientert 
  • Trives med en variert arbeidshverdag og mange oppgaver samtidig 
  • Er strukturert og selvstendig 
  • Følger rutiner og avtaleprosesser 
  • Er serviceinnstilt, positiv og fleksibel 
  • Lærer nye datasystemer raskt, og er stødig med digitale verktøy som M365.
  • Behersker norsk muntlig og skriftlig, og gjør deg forstått av andre 

Erfaring med BPA er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det er også positivt om du har kjennskap til HR, arbeidsmiljøloven eller annet relevant lovverk.

Vi kan tilby

En stilling i en spennende og meningsfull rolle med gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Som BPA-koordinator får du en variert arbeidshverdag med stor grad av selvstendighet, samtidig som du har et sterkt faglig fellesskap rundt deg. Hos oss vil du bli en del av en gjeng som liker å ha mange baller i lufta, trives med oppsøkende virksomhet og har en genuin interesse for å tilpasse og se muligheter. Abri Dialogue har kontor på Lura. Du vil få egen kontorplass, tilgang til kantine og garderobe.

Lurer du på noe? Ta kontakt da vel! Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å søke. Vi ønsker at du svarer på noen skriftlige spørsmål og ett videospørsmål. Du kan spille inn videoen så mange ganger du vil før du leverer den.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Abri Dialogue AS er en landsdekkende privat leverandør av helse- og omsorgstjenester, etablert i 2002. Vi består av seksjonene BPA og Bo og omsorg. Vi arbeider etter visjonen «Sammen skaper vi det gode liv», og våre tre kjerneverdier er: Trygghet – Vi gjør det vi sier, og vi er der når du trenger oss. Selvstendighet – Vi legger til rette for at du kan leve det livet du ønsker. Livskvalitet – Vi er her for å gjøre hverdagen enklere, rikere og mer meningsfull. Hos Abri Dialogue ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. jobs.title: Group Offshore Services Director
jobs.description:
If you're the type of person who likes to meet challenges head on, then you'll find many like-minded people here at DeepOcean.

Our clients have become accustomed to our habit of accepting complex challenges and finding safe, efficient and innovative solutions. Our company is built on a willingness to continuously improve and create lasting value. This mindset not only drives results for our business but also creates exciting opportunities for our employees.

As our new Group Offshore Services Director, you will shape how DeepOcean plans, coordinates and invests in its offshore capability across regions. Bringing together offshore personnel, project equipment and investment planning, you will help us make the most of our global resources, strengthen cost competitiveness and ensure we have the capabilities needed for the future.

You will establish a new Group function and be part of DeepOcean's corporate leadership environment, reporting directly to the COO, seated from one of DeepOceans main hubs. Working closely with regional operations, resource and asset leaders, you will create common ways of working while maintaining a clear principle: global coordination, regional execution. Together, you will improve how we use our people and assets across the Group, while regional teams retain responsibility for day-to-day operations, projects and results.

What should you do?

  • Establish the Group Offshore Services function and develop effective ways of working with the regions
  • Lead Group-wide planning for offshore personnel, improving visibility of capacity and demand and prioritising internal resources where competence and requirements allow
  • Develop plans for offshore capacity, recruitment and competence across the Group
  • Provide Group-level governance for ROVs and other major project equipment, improving utilisation and coordinating deployment, maintenance and upgrades across regions
  • Drive common systems, procedures and technical standards for offshore personnel and asset management
  • Lead investment planning for vessels and project equipment, develop business cases and follow up CAPEX budgets and projects
  • Bring regional leaders together to align priorities, resolve competing demands and deliver Group-wide improvements
  • Work closely with the Ship Management Department to align vessel, equipment and personnel planning

 

What background and expertise do you bring with you?

To be successful in this role, we believe you have:

  • Relevant higher education, preferably in engineering, although extensive relevant experience may compensate
  • At least 15 years of experience in the subsea or offshore industry, including senior management roles
  • Experience leading across regions in an international matrix organisation
  • Experience in offshore resource management and crewing, including an understanding of competence requirements for international offshore crews
  • Experience in ROV or other project-equipment management and asset governance
  • Strong commercial understanding, including investment planning, business cases, CAPEX and cost management

It would be considered an advantage if you also have:

  • Experience in vessel management and marine operations
  • Leadership or business management education
  • Knowledge of DeepOcean's organisation and operations

 

Who are you as a person?

To thrive in this role, it is beneficial if you recognise yourself in several of the following qualities:

  • A natural ability to build trust and strong working relationships across regions, functions and cultures
  • The ability to make clear decisions when needed, while respecting regional ownership and accountability
  • Confidence in leading and influencing within a matrix organisation, even without direct line authority over the resources involved
  • You combine strategic thinking with an understanding of offshore operations and commercial priorities
  • A proactive and structured approach to identifying challenges early and driving practical solutions
  • Clear communication skills and bring people together around shared goals

 

Why should you choose us?

We think that our culture, where we like to solve challenges together, is perhaps the best reason to work with us. In addition, you would receive:

  • The opportunity to establish and shape a new Group function with significant strategic impact
  • A key leadership role connecting offshore people, assets and investments across an international organisation
  • The opportunity to work with skilled colleagues across regions to improve how we plan and deliver offshore services
  • Development opportunities on both a professional and personal level
  • An employer who values flexibility and understands that everyone's everyday life is different
  • A collaborative culture where people are encouraged to challenge, improve and innovate
  • Competitive pension and insurance schemes
  • The opportunity to work on world-leading projects across the globe

We are proud to be a workplace that offers equal opportunities for all. Inclusion, equality and diversity are central to how we work, and all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

Challenge Accepted?

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

DeepOcean is a technology-driven, independent solution provider in the ocean space. We offer companies within oil and gas, offshore renewables, deep sea minerals, and other non-energy niches a full range of services – from surveys, engineering, project management, and installation to maintenance and recycling.

Our global team of experts is at the forefront of remote and unmanned operations and digitally-enabled services. Supported by an extensive tool and technology pool, they drive cost-efficient, safe and sustainable operations. DeepOcean has a GO GREEN attitude, continuously looking to make our customers’ operations more sustainable, through reducing both carbon footprint and costs.  

A world-leading ocean services provider, DeepOcean enables the energy transition and sustainable use of ocean resources.  People are the heart of our operations. It’s about technology, systems, and processes, but in the end, it is our people that deliver the services.

Deepocean has joined the United Nations Global Compact, the world's largest corporate sustainability initiative. We support the 10 United Nations Global Compact Principles on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti- corruption. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and workplace. We value inclusion, equality and diversity and encourage all qualified candidates to apply. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status or gender identity. 

Learn more about DeepOcean on http://deepoceangroup.com

jobs.title: Helgestillingar for helsefagarbeidarar - løn over tariff og ekstra helgekompensasjon
jobs.employer: GULEN KOMMUNE SONE BREKKE, DALSØYRA, BYRKNES
jobs.description:
Om stillinga 

Gulen kommune har ledig fylgjande helgestillingar i Sone Brekke, Byrknes og Dalsøyra (Sone BBD) frå snarast/etter avtale: 

  • 19% fast stilling som helsefagarbeidar. Stillinga er for tida knytt til avdeling Dalsøyra, med kortvakter kvar 3. helg
  • 13,15% fast stilling som helsefagarbeidar. Stillinga er for tida knytt til avdeling Byrknes, med arbeid kvar 3. helg, med dagvakt laurdag og søndag. 

Me tilbyr: 

  • Løn over tariff for helsefagarbeidar i turnus
  • Ekstra helgekompensasjon for gjennomført vakt 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar

I sone BBD arbeider det både nyutdanna og tilsette med lang erfaring. Det er eit tett og godt samarbeid mellom assistentar, fagarbeidarar og sjukepleiarar/vernepleiarar kvar dag. Samarbeidet er viktig for at tenestene våre skal verte best mogleg for innbyggjarane i Gulen kommune, og noko me har fokus på kontinuerleg. Eininga har fokus på fagleg utvikling og kompetanseheving blant helsefagarbeidarane. 

Arbeidsoppgåver 
  • Hjelp og bistand til brukarar med ulike funksjonsnivå
  • Følgje opp dei daglege rutinene i avdelingane
  • Andre oppgåver som måtte kome til
Kvalifikasjonskrav 
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeidar. Søkjarar utan fagbrev kan verte vurdert for mellombels stilling. 
  • Førarkort klasse B
  • Gyldig politiattest 
  • God skrifleg og munnleg framstillingsevne (norsk)
Personlege eigenskapar 
  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk, og har erfaring frå og god kjennskap til norsk helsevesen
  • Samhandlar godt med brukarar og andre samarbeidspartnarar
  • Jobbar sjølvstendig, tar initiativ, er fleksibel og løysingsorientert
  • Å vere personleg eigna kan verte vektlagt ved tilsetjing
Anna 
  • Tenestespråket i Gulen kommune er nynorsk
  • Tilsetjing etter gjeldande lover, føresegner og avtalar
  • For tilsetjing innan pleie og omsorg, miljøteneste, barnevern, i skule, SFO og i barnehage, vert det stilt krav om politiattest etter aktuell/gjeldande lovheimel før oppstart i stillinga. Det skal berre krevjast politiattest av den som får tilbod om stillinga
  • Vi gjer merksam på at søkjarlister med namn, kjønn, alder og noverande stilling er offentleg informasjon. Dersom søkjarar likevel ber om konfidensiell handsaming, og grunnen for å unnta offentleggjering ikkje vert godkjent, får søkjaren høve til å trekke søknaden sin før offentleggjering.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Gulen kommune ligg vakkert til ved innløpet til Sognefjorden. Kommunen består av både fjell- og kystlandskap, med 1500 øyer, holmar og skjær, som innbyr til eit aktivt friluftsliv både på land og ved sjøen.

Kommunen har 2260 innbyggjarar, ledige barnehageplassar, og er eit godt oppvekstmiljø for barn og unge. Sjå Gulen kommune for meir informasjon.
