jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Optimization and Decision Support for Resilient Transport Systems
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sBackground

We invite applications for a 4-year PhD Candidate position focused on optimization and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is to carry out education and research activities at a high international level in the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE to promote sustainable value creation in technology-based areas in industry, business, and public sector organizations in Norway.

About the position

Transport systems can be disrupted by events such as floods, landslides, traffic accidents, and technical failures. These disruptions can close or constrain links in the transport network, affecting the movement of passengers and goods.

This PhD project will develop optimization methods to support strategic and operational decisions in multimodal transport systems. Strategic decisions may include infrastructure investments, resource placement, and infrastructure reinforcement. Operational decisions may include rerouting traffic, allocating capacity, and planning recovery.

You will work closely with another PhD candidate who is developing dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods to predict how the network performs under different conditions. You will integrate these models into optimization methods, allowing, for example, many scenarios and resilience measures to be evaluated efficiently.

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How can optimization support strategic investment and resource-allocation decisions for resilient transport systems?
  • How can dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods improve optimization across many possible scenarios?
  • How can optimization support rerouting, capacity allocation, and recovery decisions when parts of a transport system are unavailable?

The PhD candidate will develop models for strategic resilience planning and operational disruption management. The research will examine how to balance efficiency, redundancy, recovery, and societal requirements.

Use cases will be developed in close collaboration with project partners, including Norway’s railway infrastructure manager (Bane NOR), the Norwegian Public Roads Administration (Statens vegvesen), and the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI). The candidate will work with partners to examine practical decisions related to transport resilience.

The position offers an opportunity to develop optimization methods for important decisions about transport resilience, in collaboration with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, infrastructure, and social sciences.

Research environment

The PhD position is part of STRIDE: Synergizing Transport Resilience, Infrastructure, and Defense in Extremes, an interdisciplinary research project involving researchers in transport modelling, machine learning, optimization, infrastructure, and social sciences.

The project studies how transport systems respond to disruptions and how modelling and decision-support methods can strengthen resilience across planning, response, and recovery. The PhD candidate will work closely with three other PhD candidates studying interdependent hazards, data-driven modelling of multimodal transport, and the societal dimensions of resilience and total defense.

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project
  • Conduct original scientific research related to the project topic
  • Develop optimization models and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences
  • Collaborate with academic and industry partners
  • Integrate dynamic transport models and machine-learning surrogates developed in a parallel PhD project into optimization methods
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research results
Required selection criteria
  • Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU's grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:
    • Operations research or optimization
    • Applied mathematics
    • Industrial engineering
    • Transport or logistics
    • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Applicants must document competence in mathematical optimization, operations research, and/or related quantitative methods.
  • The position requires excellent English oral and writing skills.  

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Good knowledge of mathematical optimization, such as mixed-integer programming, stochastic programming, or robust optimization
  • Experience with optimization under uncertainty
  • Experience with algorithm development
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, e.g, Python, Julia, C++, or similar
  • Knowledge of machine learning 

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in interdisciplinary research environments
  • Is interested in developing research with practical relevance and societal impact

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Opportunities to collaborate with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, and infrastructure
  • Close interaction with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in an interdisciplinary research project on resilient transport systems
  • Opportunities for research stays at international universities
  •  follow-up during the PhD period
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

PhD candidates are remunerated in code 1017, currently NOK 580.000,- per year before tax. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The employment period is 4 years, of which 3 years is for the doctoral work and 1 year for career enhancing work, such as, teaching and supervision activities.

Appointment requires admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Economics and Management at NTNU.Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of three potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

Questions about the position can be directed to Associate Professor Steffen Jaap Skotvoll Bakker, steffen.bakker@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Hilde Selli Egelie at hilde.s.egelie@ntnu.no.

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

Application deadline: 20.11.2026 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management

We conduct research and teaching at an international level in the interface between technology/natural sciences and economics, management, and HSE (health, safety and the environment). Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is one of four departments in the Faculty of Economics and Management.

YOUR TEAMYou will join our Brand Identity team and work alongside creative colleagues across graphic design, art direction, photography and other areas of brand communication.Together, we bring SELECTED's visual identity to life across channels and markets. Campaigns move quickly from idea to execution, so close collaboration, good creative sparring and the ability to keep several deliveries moving at once are part of everyday life.

YOUR ROLEYour main focus will be creating and adapting visual content for our digital channels, particularly CRM and Paid Media. You will take established concepts and translate them into strong executions across formats, platforms and markets, while keeping SELECTED's visual expression consistent.

More specifically, you will:

  • Design layouts and visual assets for newsletters and CRM campaigns.

  • Create and adapt artwork for Paid Media across platforms and formats.

  • Resize and adjust creative assets for different channels and markets.

  • Create moving content such as animations and short-form video.

  • Support the wider creative team with ad hoc graphic design tasks.

YOUR BENEFITS

  • See your work go live across channels and markets, from weekly CRM campaigns to Paid Media and moving content.

  • Build breadth in your digital design experience, working across formats, platforms and different types of creative execution.

  • Join a strong creative environment, where you work closely with colleagues across design, creative and marketing and have room to contribute with your creative perspectives within SELECTED’s established visual identity and creative direction.

  • Enjoy flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home as part of our way of working.

YOUR PROFILEYou are a skilled Graphic Designer with a strong visual eye and a feel for what makes digital content engaging and on-brand. You enjoy turning creative direction into strong executions and take pride in the details that make the final result come together.

We imagine that you:

  • Have at least 2 years of experience in graphic design, preferably working with digital content.

  • Are highly skilled in Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop, After Effects, InDesign and Illustrator.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

Hylleraas Centre for Quantum Molecular Sciences operates under the aegis of the Department of Chemistry at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. The Department of Chemistry  is Norway's largest institution within research and education in chemistry. Our research excels internationally and we educate students to a wide variety of jobs in industry, academia, research institutions, schools and public administration. Our research ranges from the core topics of chemistry to applied science within in environmental, health, energy and materials. 

The Department has extensive contacts with industry, research and educational institutions at home and abroad. As partner in the Centre for Materials Science and Nanotechnology our researchers contributes to a significant interdisciplinary efforts in cooperation with the Department of Physics. The Department of Chemistry has its own school laboratory as a great resource for teachers, public outreach and the didactics of chemistry.

jobs.title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director and lead through an Associate Facility Technical Manager, shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Thon Hotel Straume søker Salgssjef
jobs.description:
Salgssjef Konferanse & Bedriftsmarked

Bli med og bygg Vestlandets nye møteplass før dørene åpner!

Thon Hotel Straume | The Coastal Conference City

På Straume, bare minutter fra Bergen sentrum, bygger vi nå et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanse.

I første kvartal 2029 åpner nye Thon Hotel Straume med 189 hotellrom, kapasitet for 700 konferansegjester og en storsal for opptil 300 personer.

Her får du oppleve en destinasjon hvor kystens rå energi møter byens puls og en spennende møteplass og konferansedestinasjon.

Vi kaller det The Coastal Conference City.

Nå ser vi etter salgssjefen som skal være med å bygge markedet lenge før bygget står ferdig.

Er du komfortabel med å selge en visjon?

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell salgsrolle.

De neste årene skal du fylle ordreboken for et hotell og konferanseanlegg som fortsatt er under bygging. Du må klare å få kunder til å se det vi ser. Du må kunne tegne bildene, fortelle historien og skape entusiasme for en destinasjon som vokser frem måned for måned.

Vi ser etter deg som tror på prosjektet, ser mulighetene i Øygarden og evner å gjøre våre fremtidige gjester like begeistret som vi er.

Du blir en sentral del av prosjektet og får følge utviklingen fra byggeplass til ferdig destinasjon samt en del av hotellets ledergruppe.

Hva skal du gjøre?

Du får ansvaret for å etablere og utvikle konferanse- og bedriftsmarkedet for nye Thon Hotel Straume.

Dette innebærer blant annet å:

  • Bygge og utvikle en solid portefølje av bedriftskunder og samarbeidspartnere

  • Selge møter, konferanser, arrangementer og hotellavtaler flere år frem i tid

  • Bygge opp ordreboken mot åpningen i 2029

  • Utvikle relasjoner innen MICE-markedet (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events)

  • Jobbe med hotellavtaler, prosjektavtaler og langsiktige rammeavtaler

  • Gjennomføre kundemøter, presentasjoner, nettverksaktiviteter og befaringer

  • Samarbeide tett med drift, booking og ledelse om produkter, konsepter og kommersiell utvikling

  • Være en ambassadør for både Thon Hotel Straume, The Coastal Conference City og destinasjonen Øygarden

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å åpne dører og skape nye muligheter.

Du trives når målet ligger langt fremme, og du lar deg ikke stoppe av at bygget fortsatt er under oppføring.

Kanskje jobber du allerede med hotellsalg, konferansesalg eller annen kompleks B2B-salg. Kanskje kommer du fra reiseliv, opplevelser eller prosjektbasert salg.

Det viktigste er at du:

  • Har dokumenterte resultater innen salg

  • Trives med oppsøkende salgsarbeid

  • Er strukturert og god på langsiktig oppfølging

  • Evner å bygge tillit og relasjoner på alle nivåer

  • Har kommersiell forståelse og ser verdien i gode kundeavtaler

  • Er en inspirerende historieforteller som kan selge både visjon og virkelighet

  • Har tro på Øygarden som destinasjon og mulighetene prosjektet representerer

Hvorfor velge oss?

Fordi dette er en sjelden mulighet.

Du får være med helt fra starten og sette ditt preg på et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanseprosjekter.

Du blir med på å skrive neste kapittel i hotelleventyret på Straume.

Du får påvirke strategi, kundeportefølje og markedsposisjon.

Og når dørene åpner i 2029, vil du kunne se tilbake på noe få salgsledere får oppleve:

At du var med på å bygge markedet før produktet eksisterte.

Vi tilbyr

  • En unik rolle i utviklingen av The Coastal Conference City

  • Muligheten til å bygge opp konferansemarkedet fra grunnen av

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø og en av Norges mest solide merkevarer i ryggen

  • Stor frihet og påvirkningskraft

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Arbeidssted ved Thon Hotel Straume

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Yrittäjärekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppania
jobs.description: Haemme 2–3 yrittäjärekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppania, kyseessä ei ole työpaikka!**Franchisetori kasvaa ja kansainvälistyy. Tule mukaan rakentamaan franchisingketjujen kasvua!**Etsimme 2–3 itsenäistä yrittäjää yhteistyökumppaneiksemme toteuttamaan franchisingyrittäjien rekrytointeja Suomessa.Franchisetori on franchisingliiketoiminnan rakentamiseen, kehittämiseen ja yrittäjärekrytointiin erikoistunut asiantuntijayritys. Meillä on noin 25 vuoden kokemus franchisingalalta, ja olemme olleet mukana yli 500 sopimukseen johtaneessa yrittäjärekrytoinnissa. Asiakkainamme on sekä suomalaisia että kansainvälisiä franchisingketjuja eri toimialoilta.Toimintamme kasvaessa etsimme verkostoomme osaavia, tavoitteellisia ja yrittäjähenkisiä rekrytoinnin ammattilaisia pitkäaikaiseen yhteistyöhön.Mitä tehtävä sisältää?Franchisingyrittäjien rekrytointi on tavoitteellista myynti- ja rekrytointityötä, jossa tarvitaan sekä kaupallista osaamista että kykyä arvioida ihmisten soveltuvuutta yrittäjiksi.Tehtävässä vastaat sovittujen toimeksiantojen yrittäjäehdokkaiden kartoittamisesta, aktiivisesta suorahausta, kontaktoinnista, haastatteluista ja rekrytointiprosessin edistämisestä aina franchisingsopimuksen syntymiseen asti.Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Franchisetorin rekrytointipäällikön kanssa, joka toimii ensisijaisena yhteyshenkilönäsi ja koordinoi rekrytointitoimeksiantojen etenemistä. Franchisetorin johto vastaa asiakassuhteista ja asiakassopimuksista.Meille on tärkeää, että rekrytointikumppanimme ymmärtävät franchisingyrittäjyyden erityispiirteet. Tehtävässä pitää osata sekä myydä että ostaa. On osattava herättää kiinnostus yrittäjyysmahdollisuuteen ja samalla selvittää, vastaavatko ehdokkaan osaaminen, motivaatio, taloudelliset valmiudet ja tavoitteet ketjun vaatimuksia.Tavoitteena ei ole löytää mahdollisimman paljon hakijoita, vaan oikeat yrittäjät oikeisiin franchisingketjuihin.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Edellytämme vahvaa myynti- ja neuvotteluosaamista sekä kokemusta rekrytoinnista, suorahausta tai tavoitteellisesta B2B-myynnistä. Arvostamme kykyä rakentaa luottamusta, käydä vaativiakin keskusteluja ja viedä pitkät rekrytointiprosessit suunnitelmallisesti loppuun.**Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito on välttämätön.** Työskentelemme myös kansainvälisten franchisingketjujen kanssa, joten molempien kielten osaamista tarvitaan käytännön työssä.Odotamme lisäksi oma-aloitteisuutta, järjestelmällisyyttä, hyviä digitaalisia työskentelytaitoja, aktiivista suorahakuotetta ja vastuullista suhtautumista luottamuksellisiin asiakas- ja hakijatietoihin.Aiempi kokemus franchisingliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä. Tärkeintä on vahva kaupallinen osaaminen, rekrytointikyky ja halu perehtyä franchisingtoimintaan.Missä toimimme?Asiakasyrityksemme sijaitsevat tällä hetkellä pääosin pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta rekrytoimme franchisingyrittäjiä eri puolille Suomea.Toimeksiantoihin voi sisältyä tapaamisia asiakkaiden ja yrittäjäehdokkaiden kanssa eri paikkakunnilla. Yhteistyötä voi tehdä joustavasti omasta toimipaikasta käsin, joten kumppanimme voivat sijaita eri puolilla Suomea.Mitä tarjoamme?Tarjoamme valmiita asiakastoimeksiantoja, franchisingalan asiantuntemusta, rekrytointimateriaaleja, perehdytystä toimintamalliimme sekä rekrytointipäällikön tuen toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen.Pääset työskentelemään erilaisten suomalaisten ja kansainvälisten franchisingketjujen kanssa ja osallistumaan niiden kasvuun. Tavoitteenamme on rakentaa pitkäaikainen, molempia osapuolia hyödyttävä yhteistyöverkosto.Yhteistyö ja palkkioKyseessä on **itsenäisten yrittäjien välinen toimeksiantoyhteistyö, ei työsuhteinen tehtävä**.Yhteistyö perustuu onnistumispalkkioon, jonka suuruus sovitaan etukäteen toimeksiantokohtaisesti. Palkkio maksetaan sovittujen ehtojen mukaisesti onnistuneesta, franchisingsopimukseen johtaneesta rekrytoinnista. Kiinteää tunti- tai kuukausikorvausta ei makseta.Yhteistyökumppanilla tulee olla oma yritys tai valmius perustaa yritys yhteistyötä varten.**Yhteistyötä voi tehdä myös oman työn tai muun yritystoiminnan ohella.**Tehtävä ei edellytä kokoaikaista sitoutumista, vaan voit ottaa vastaan toimeksiantoja oman työtilanteesi ja käytettävissä olevan aikasi mukaan. Edellytämme kuitenkin sitoutumista sovittuihin rekrytointiprosesseihin, niiden laadukkaaseen hoitamiseen ja aktiiviseen yhteistyöhön Franchisetorin rekrytointipäällikön kanssa.Yhteistyö perustuu itsenäiseen yrittäjätoimintaan ja toimeksiantokohtaiseen onnistumispalkkioon. jobs.title: Sanitør til skadeservice | bliv en del af Ocab i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Når andre oplever en af deres værste dage, er du med til at gøre en forskelHos Ocab hjælper vi mennesker og virksomheder videre efter brand-, vand- ogskimmelskader. Vi søger nu en sanitør til vores afdeling i Aarhus, som har lyst tilen hverdag med mening, ansvar og gode kolleger.Du bliver en del af et engageret team med stor erfaring inden for skadeservice.Sammen arbejder I for at sikre, at vores kunder hurtigt kan vende tilbage til ennormal hverdag.

Om jobbet

Som sanitør hos Ocab bliver du en vigtig del af indsatsen, når skaden er sket. Duarbejder både selvstændigt og sammen med dine kolleger, og du får en varierethverdag med opgaver hos både private, virksomheder og forsikringsselskaber.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Blotlægning og nedrivning i forbindelse med vandskader

  • Skimmelsanering

  • Opsætning og tilsyn med affugtningsudstyr

  • Dokumentation af opgaver fra start til slut

  • Deltagelse i vores døgnvagtsordning

  • Tæt samarbejde med kolleger og projektledere

  • Asbestsanering

  • Sanering efter skadedyr

  • Rengøring og sanering efter brandskader

  • Oprydning og rengøring i forbindelse med socialsager

Vi forestiller os, at du

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag, men vi håber, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra skadeservice eller lignende branche – erfaring medskadeservice vil være en klar fordel

  • Har asbestbevis eller erfaring med asbestsanering (en fordel, men ikke etkrav)

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og sætter en ære i et godt stykke arbejde

  • Trives i et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde

  • Er fleksibel og bevarer overblikket – også når der er travlt

  • Bor i rimelig afstand til vores afdeling i Aarhus (gerne inden for ca. 30-40 km)

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort (kategori B)

Det er en forudsætning, at du kan fremvise straffeattest.

Vi ved, at den rette kollega kan have forskellige erfaringer med sig. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rigtige indstilling, tager ansvar og har lyst til at lære.

Hvem er Ocab?

Ocab er en af Nordens førende virksomheder inden for skadeservice ogindustriservice. Vi hjælper hvert år tusindvis af kunder efter blandt andet brand-,vand- og klimaskader.Hos os bliver du en del af en virksomhed med høj faglighed, moderne udstyr ogengagerede kolleger. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem samarbejde,ordentlighed og en stærk holdånd

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og afvekslende hverdag

  • Grundig oplæring og gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • Løn efter overenskomst

  • Pension og sundhedsordning

  • 37 timers arbejdsuge

  • Normal arbejdstid mandag-fredag kl. 07.00-15.00

  • Deltagelse i døgnvagtsordning

Arbejdssted: Ocab Aarhus afdelingen, Haslegårdsvænget 16, 8210 Aarhus

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rettekandidat.Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@ocab.dk.Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakt afdelingsleder Anders T. Madsen påtlf. +45 55 66 68 41.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjä Salicolle
jobs.description: Haemme Salico Oy:lle kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjää toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Helsingin Kivikossa sijaitsevalle elintarviketuotantolaitokselle. Salico valmistaa tuoreita hedelmä- ja vihannesjalosteita sekä monipuolisia food-to-go-tuotteita, kuten salaatteja, wrappeja ja leipiä. Osana Picadeli Groupia Salico toimii tuoreiden elintarvikkeiden ja valmiiden ateriaratkaisujen parissa.Kunnossapidon tiiminvetäjänäpääset varmistamaan tuotantolaitoksen koneiden ja laitteiden toimintavarmuutta sekä kehittämään kunnossapidon toimintaa osana elintarviketeollisuuden vaativaa tuotantoympäristöä. Tuotannossa yhdistyvät moderni tuotantoteknologia, automaatio ja tarkasti valvotut prosessit, joissa laadulla, hygienialla ja elintarviketurvallisuudella on keskeinen merkitys.Työtehtäviisi kuuluukunnossapitotöiden suunnittelu ja koordinointi, työmenetelmien kehittäminen ja standardointi sekä toimintatapojen kouluttaminen. Vastaat kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä sekä varaosien hallinnoinnista. Osallistut myös vikaselvityksiin ja tarvittaessa akuutteihin korjauksiin. Tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään käytännön teknisen osaamisen, ennakoivan kunnossapidon ja toiminnan jatkuvan kehittämisen.Kunnossapitotiimiin kuuluu neljä asentajaa, jotka työskentelevät kahdessa porrastetussa vuorossa. Kunnossapitotoiminnot on ulkoistettu, joten tehtävään ei kuulu suoraa esihenkilövastuuta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon työnjohdon ja tuotannonsuunnittelun kanssa ja raportoit tekniselle päällikölle.Odotamme sinultatehtävään soveltuvaa sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan koulutusta sekä kokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta. Sinulla on käytännönläheinen ja järjestelmällinen ote työhön, ja ymmärrät ennakoivan kunnossapidon sekä kunnonvalvonnan merkityksen tuotantolaitteiden toimintavarmuudelle. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä koordinoida kunnossapitotöitä kustannustehokkaasti. Työturvallisuus, elintarviketurvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat kaikkea tekemistä tuotantoympäristössä. Odotamme henkilöltä sujuvaa suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa.Eduksi katsommekokemuksen kunnossapidon toiminnanohjausjärjestelmistä ja niiden kehittämisestä sekä osaamisen työmenetelmien standardoinnista. Myös kiinteistötekniikan tuntemus on tehtävässä hyödyksi.Tarjoammemonipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän elintarviketeollisuuden tuotantolaitoksessa, jossa kunnossapidolla on tärkeä rooli tuotannon sujuvuuden, laadun ja toimintavarmuuden varmistamisessa. Pääset kehittämään kunnossapidon prosesseja, vaikuttamaan ennakoivan kunnossapidon toteutumiseen ja työskentelemään modernin tuotantoteknologian parissa. Tarjoamme toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen, jossa yhdistyvät tekninen asiantuntemus, käytännön ongelmanratkaisu ja yhteistyö tuotannon eri toimintojen kanssa.Mikäli kiinnostuittehtävästä, hae mukaan ja tule kehittämään Salicon kunnossapitoa osana tuoreiden elintarvikkeiden tuotantoa! Haethan tehtävään oheisen linkin kautta. Aloitamme hakemusten jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Töiden aloitus tapahtuu sopimuksen mukaan. Huomaathan että emme käsittele sähköpostilla lähetettyjä hakemuksia tietoturvasyistä.Lisätietoja Baronalta antaa Ari Kumlander, ari.kumlander@barona.fiRekrytointitoteutetaan yhteistyössä Baronan kanssa. Kaikki yhteydenotot rekrytointiin liittyen tulee tehdä Baronalle.

jobs.title: Billackerare / Car painters / Varnishers
jobs.employer: Moses Bil o Lack Tollarp AB
jobs.description: VerksamhetsbeskrivningMoses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB är inte bara en arbetsplats, det är ett center för innovation och hantverksskicklighet inom bilindustrin. Beläget strax söder om Kristianstad, arbetar vi med en varierad kundbas som inkluderar försäkringsbolag, företag och privatpersoner. Vårt team på cirka 60 engagerade medarbetare arbetar i toppmoderna faciliteter, utrustade för att hantera allt från småreparationer till avancerade lackeringsuppdrag.Som auktoriserad servicepartner till Volkswagen, Skoda, Seat och Tesla, och med erfarenhet av att arbeta med de exklusiva bilarna från Koenigsegg, har vi etablerat oss som ett ledande fullservicecenter inom bilreparation och lackering. Att vi får förtroendet att lackera bilar från Koenigsegg är ett kvitto på vår strävan efter perfektion och vår förmåga att leverera resultat i världsklass.ArbetsuppgifterVi söker nu passionerade och skickliga yrkespersoner som vill bli en del av vårt växande team. Vi har lediga tjänster för både förberedelsearbetare så som spacklare och maskerare samt polerare som brinner för detaljer och perfektion. I din roll kommer du att arbeta med en varierad flotta av bilar – allt från vardagsbilar till exklusiva modeller värda miljoner. Varje uppdrag kräver noggrannhet och ett öga för detaljer, och du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att säkerställa att varje bil lämnar vårt center i perfekt skick.Vad vi erbjuder    Arbete med prestigeprojekt: Du får möjlighet att arbeta med bilar från några av världens mest exklusiva märken, inklusive Koenigsegg.    Moderna arbetsmiljöer: Våra faciliteter är toppmoderna och utrustade med den senaste teknologin inom bilreparation och lackering.    Ett sammansvetsat team: Hos oss är du inte bara en anställd, utan en del av en familj som stöttar varandra och strävar efter gemensamma mål.    Personlig utveckling: Vi värderar kompetens och erfarenhet, och ger dig möjligheten att utvecklas och växa inom företaget.    Kollektivt boende: Vi erbjuder kollektivboende som är på gång avstånd från arbetsplatsen .Vem är du?Vi söker dig som har omfattande erfarenhet inom bilförberedelse. Formell utbildning är meriterande, men inte ett krav – vi lägger större vikt vid din erfarenhet och de resultat du kan uppvisa. Du är en flexibel, pålitlig och dedikerad person som sätter kvalitet i första rummet. Ditt öga för detaljer och din förmåga att arbeta med precision, även under tidspress, är avgörande för att lyckas i denna roll.Ansök nuÄr du redo att ta nästa steg i din karriär och bli en del av ett företag där perfektion är normen? Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB.VACANCY NOTICE IN ENGLISHAbout the JobCompany DescriptionMoses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB is not just a workplace; it's a hub of innovation and craftsmanship in the automotive industry. Located just south of Kristianstad, we serve a diverse clientele including insurance companies, businesses, and private individuals. Our team of around 60 dedicated employees works in state-of-the-art facilities, equipped to handle everything from minor repairs to advanced painting projects.As an authorized service partner for Volkswagen, Skoda, Seat and Tesla, and with experience working on the exclusive Koenigsegg cars, we have established ourselves as a leading full-service center in car repair and painting. Being entrusted with painting Koenigsegg vehicles is a testament to our pursuit of perfection and our ability to deliver world-class results.Job ResponsibilitiesWe are now seeking passionate and skilled professionals to join our growing team. We have openings for both preparation specialists and experienced painters who are dedicated to detail and perfection. In your role, you will work with a diverse range of vehicles—from everyday cars to exclusive models worth millions. Each task requires meticulousness and an eye for detail, and you will play a crucial role in ensuring every car leaves our center in perfect condition.What We Offer    Prestigious Projects: You will have the opportunity to work on vehicles from some of the world’s most exclusive brands, including Koenigsegg.    Modern Work Environment: Our facilities are state-of-the-art and equipped with the latest technology in car repair and painting.    A Close-Knit Team: Here, you are not just an employee; you are part of a family that supports each other and strives towards common goals.    Personal Development: We value skills and experience and provide opportunities for you to grow and develop within the company.    Relocation package/Accomodation: We are offering accomodation. The accomodation is very close (walking distance) and is owned by the employer.    Help with administrative issues: The employer will also help you with administrative issues about living and working in Sweden.﻿Who You AreWe are looking for individuals with extensive experience in car preparation or painting. Formal education is advantageous but not required; we place more importance on your experience and the results you can demonstrate. You are a flexible, reliable, and dedicated person who prioritizes quality. Your attention to detail and ability to work with precision, even under pressure, are essential to succeed in this role.Apply NowReady to take the next step in your career and be part of a company where perfection is the standard? Submit your application today and join Moses Bil & Lack Tollarp AB.

jobs.description: CNC Press Brake Programmer / OperatorJoin Our Team as a CNC Press Brake Programmer / Operator!Are you an experienced CNC Press Brake Operator with programming skills? jobs.description: Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta henkilöltä suoritettua LVV- tai LKV-tutkintoa. Osaat aikatauluttaa omaa työntekoasi ja työskentelet tarkalla otteella. Pystyt työskentelemään asiakkaiden kanssa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi. Koska saat pitkälti suunnitella omien työpäiviesi aikataulun, toivomme, että pystyt myös itse tarpeen tullen joustamaan. Työ on lähtökohtaisesti osa-aikaista, mutta mahdollisuus myös kokoaikaiseen työhön. Oma auto on tässä työssä välttämätön.Teemme välitystyötä modernilla otteella, suunnitelmallisesti ja jatkuvasti uudistuen. Toivomme, että sinulla on niin osaamista kuin halua erilaisten digitaalisten välineiden ja järjestelmien kuin sosiaalisen mediankin hyödyntämiseen.Meidän rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä on helppo viihtyä. Saat aina tarvittaessa myös apua työkavereilta. Tulet saamaan työnantajan puolesta jonkin verran toimeksiantoja, jotta aloitus meillä olisi mahdollisimman sujuvaa.Joustavan työajan lisäksi tarjoamme kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen ja korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä johtuvat kilometrit. Työsuhde-etuna pääset seuraamaan asuntosijoittamista läheltä ja ensimmäisenä mukaan sijoitusasuntojen tarjouksiimme.Hakuaika on 2.-15.11.2026. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana. Tehtävän aloitusajankohta sopimuksen mukaan. Työhön valitulta tarkistetaan luottotiedot.Lähetä CV ja työhakemuksesi viimeistään 15.11.2026 osoitteeseen karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi otsikolla Välittäjän rekry/Rovaniemi.Kysy tehtävästä lisää: Karoliina Peltola, Tiimipäällikkö, Asuntopehtoori karoliina.peltola@asuntopehtoori.fi p. 044 768 0122

jobs.title: Chef du service facturation et dépenses (m/f/d) (H/F)
jobs.description: Qui recrute ? Direction Administrative et Financier/ière (DAF)La Direction Administrative et Financier/ière assure la gestion administrative, financier/ière et des ressources humaines du CGDIS. Elle veille à une utilisation rigoureur/euse et efficiente des ressources tout en garantissant le respect du cadre légal et réglementaire. Grâce à son approche transversale, elle soutient l'ensemble des directions dans leurs missions et accompagne les évolutions organisationnelles, les projets stratégiques et les démarches d'innovation. Missions Vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences en gestion financier/ière et en management au service d'un établissement engagé quotidien/iennement pour la sécurité de la population ? En tant que Chef du service dépenses et facturation au sein du CGDIS, vous jouez un rôle essentiel dans la bonne gestion des dépenses et des recettes liées aux prestations de l'établissement. À la tête de votre service, vous accompagnez vos équipes, garantissez la fiabilité des opérations comptables et contribuez activement à l'amélioration des processus financiers et administratifs. En étroite collaboration avec votre chef de département, vous veillez à une gestion efficace, rigoureur/euse et adaptée aux besoins du CGDIS. Encadrer, accompagner et coordonner les collaborateurs du service;Piloter les activités du service, définir les priorités et optimiser l'organisation du travail;Superviser le traitement des factures fournisseurs et veiller au respect des procédures et délais de paiement;Garantir la qualité du processus de facturation des interventions des ambulances et des sapeurs-pompiers;Assurer le suivi des créances et la gestion des dossiers complexes ou litigieux;Développer les compétences de vos collaborateurs et favoriser la collaboration entre les équipes;Contribuer à l'amélioration continue et à la modernisation des processus administratifs et financiers;Élaborer des tableaux de bord et des rapports permettant de suivre les performances du service. Profil Compétences techniques Disposer de solides connaissances en comptabilité générale et analytique;Maîtriser les processus de facturation, de contrôle administratif et de gestion des dépenses;Connaître les règles relatives à la gestion des fournisseurs et des marchés;Disposer de compétences en management, en pilotage d'un service et en gestion de projets;Savoir organiser les activités, définir les priorités et gérer des situations complexes;Maîtriser les outils informatiques de gestion comptable et financier/ière ainsi que les outils de reporting;Être capable d'analyser les données financier/ières et de proposer des pistes d'amélioration;Être titulaire d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B en cours de validité. Atouts Disposer d'une expérience d'au moins 5 ans dans une fonction similaire;Posséder une expérience approfondie dans la gestion d'un service ou d'une équipe;Avoir suivi des formations dans le domaine du management d'équipe;Connaître le fonctionnement et l'organisation du CGDIS. Conditions d'admission Ce poste peut être pourvu sous le statut de fonctionnaire de l'État ou d'employé de l'État. Vous n'avez pas à choisir votre statut au moment de postuler : celui-ci est déterminé au terme du processus de recrutement, en fonction des conditions à remplir pour chaque statut. Le poste est également ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission :Découvrir les différents statutsEn savoir plus sur le changement d'administration Niveau d'étudesVous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un bachelor en comptabilité, finances, ou gestion d'entreprise ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 6 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. ExpérienceVous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. LanguesVous devez remplir les conditions générales de connaissance des trois langues administratives. Ces conditions ne s'appliquent pas dans le cadre d'un changement d'administration. Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne. ImportantSeules les candidatures introduites via la plateforme officielle GovJobs.lu seront prises en considération. Toute candidature transmise par un autre canal (e-mail, courrier, etc.) ne pourra pas être retenue.

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

An organisation based in Zaventem operating within the property sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Sales Support Specialist, you play a central role in ensuring a smooth and professional experience for our business partners and internal stakeholders.You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Finance, Operations, and our external partners, supporting the full lifecycle of sales-related requests.This role goes beyond pure administration. You work within structured procedures, but you also think proactively, communicate clearly, and help ensure that everything runs efficiently in a service-driven environment.What you will do

  • Act as the main contact person for business partners and internal teams within the sales support scope
  • Provide administrative and operational support to the sales team
  • Register, process, and follow up on requests and applications through the full workflow, including validation with financial partners

  • Support the onboarding of new business partners, guiding them through tools, processes, and ways of working
  • Maintain an overview of contracts, ongoing files, and partnership-related communication
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and communication

  • At least 2 years of experience in a sales support, administrative, or coordination role
  • Experience in service-oriented environments such as banking, insurance, leasing, or similar sectors is a strong asset
  • A structured and process-oriented mindset, with strong attention to detail
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
  • Strong communication skills, with a customer- and partner-oriented approach
  • Ability to work independently, while also thriving in a close-knit team where collaboration is key
  • Languages: Very good knowledge of Dutch or French, with professional working knowledge of the other language
  • English is a plus
  • Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools and web-based applications
  • No advanced financial calculations required; a basic understanding of financial concepts is sufficient
