jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en administrativ kundeservicemedarbejder?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

  • Afrekenen gebeurt steeds correct zodat de kassa steeds klopt op het einde van de dag.

  • We kunnen op jouw aanwezigheid en volle goesting rekenen zodat de klanten tevreden de zaak verlaten.
  • Je beheerst de Nederlands, Engels en Franse taal voldoende om te kunnen communiceren met onze klanten die uit alle hoeken van de wereld komen.

Zin om deel uit te maken van ons team?

Bel ons snel!

  • Enige ervaring is vereist zodat je zelfstandig kan werken
  • Je werkt in onze zaak alsof het voor jezelf zou zijn en dit met een goede dosis goesting
  • Onmiddellijk beschikbaar zodat je er meteen kan invliegen aangezien het seizoen reeds gestart is
  • Elke ochtend verschijn je stipt en monter

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille nuorille/teineille
jobs.description: Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia nuoria tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on mahdollisuus ottaa sijoitukseen teini-ikäisiä lapsia ja kykyä vastata heidän vaativiinkin tarpeisiinsa.Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä.-Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroaEnnen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. Osa valmennustapaamisista on perhekohtaisia ja osa toteutuu ryhmässä muiden valmennettavien perheiden kanssa (etäyhteydellä). Valmennus on prosessi, jonka kesto on keskimäärin 5-7kk.Perhehoitajana eli sijaisvanhempana toimiminen edellyttää:-Ikä noin 25-60 vuotta. Tätä ikähaitaria voi hieman venyttää lapsen iästä riippuen, mutta ajatuksena on, että henkilön tulee olla kypsä päättämään pitkästä (mahdollisesti yli kymmenen vuoden) sitoutumisesta ja henkilön ei tulisi saavuttaa eläkeikää, ennen kuin lapsi on täysi-ikäinen.-Vakaa talous ja elämäntilanne. Traumatisoituneiden ja erityistarpeisten lasten hoitaminen on vaativaa ja jos oma elämäntilanne ei ole tasapainossa, saattaa se vaikuttaa voimavaroihin ja kyvykkyyteen toimia sijaisperheenä.-Ei mielenterveys-, päihde- eikä rikostaustaa. Nämä lienevät itsestään selviä esteitä.-Sopiva asumismuoto. Teinille pitää pystyä järjestämään omaa huonetta.Arvostamme seuraavia asioita, mutta tiedämme, ettei koko listan mukaista superperhettä välttämättä löydy. Näiden lisäksi erilaiset terapeuttiset, ohjaukselliset ja psykiatriset lisäkoulutukset tarjoavat vahvaa tukea työssä menestymiseen. Virallista koulutusvaatimusta ei perhehoitajan työssä kuitenkaan ole.Aikaisempi työkokemus voisi esimerkiksi olla joku näistä:-Lastenkodin ohjaaja, perhetyöntekijä, sosiaaliohjaaja-Opettaja, erityisopettaja, varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja-Sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja-Psykologi / psykoterapeutti / toimintaterapeutti-Nuoriso-ohjaaja, yhteisöpedagogiTai muu vastaava työkokemus.Perhehoitajan tehtävässä pärjää parhaiten, jos osaa nähdä lapsen mahdollisesti haastavan käytöksen taakse ja ymmärtää aiempien elämänkokemusten merkityksen lapsen kasvulle ja kehitykselle. Työssä tarvitaan joustavuutta ja valmiutta ymmärtää ja kohdata lapsen biologinen perhe ja suku, eli läheisverkostot. Tämä voi joskus olla haastavaa, koska lapsen sijoitus herättää vanhemmissa usein paljon tunteita. Työhön kuuluu myös yhteistyötä sosiaalitoimen sekä muiden viranomaisverkostojen kanssa. Sijoitettu lapsi tarvitsee turvallisen kodin, paljon aikuisen huomiota, säännöllisyyttä ja rutiineja sekä tietysti kiintymystä, läheisyyttä ja rakkautta. Lapsesta tulee vähitellen sijaisperheen tärkeä ja tasaveroinen perheenjäsen.Sijaisperheen arki mukailee tavallista lapsiperhearkea, sisältäen arkea ja juhlaa, itkua ja naurua. Perheen toisen vanhemman tulee jäädä kotiin hoitamaan sijoitettua lasta/lapsia ainakin vuodeksi, jotta kiintymyssuhde ja asettuminen perheeseen mahdollistuu. Työn tukena on meiltä ammattitaitoinen tukityöntekijä, jonka kanssa käydään säännöllisesti läpi kuulumiset sekä paneudutaan lapsen asioihin myös syvällisemmin, lapsen yksilöllinen tilanne huomioiden. Kuljemme sijaisperheen rinnalla ja meille on tärkeää saavuttaa avoin ja luotettava yhteistyösuhde. Tukityömme on säännöllistä ja toteutuu puheluin ja kotikäynnein. Tukityön lisäksi tarjoamme perhehoitajillemme työnohjauksen ja lisäkoulutusmahdollisuuksia.Suomen Perhekodit Oy on nuori suomalainen yritys. Valmennamme ja tuemme sijaisperheitä arjen tilanteissa, koko lapsen perheessä asumisen ajan. Huolehdimme byrokratiasta niin että sinä voit huolehtia lapsesta ilman turhaa stressiä. Verkkosivuiltamme löydät kattavat tiedot sijaisperheenä toimimisesta.Ota yhteyttä, niin mietitään yhdessä, olisiko teidän perheenne sopiva sijaisperheeksi!

jobs.title: Pitkäaikainen sijaisperhe huostaanotetuille lapsille
jobs.description: Olisitko valmis auttamaan apua tarvitsevia lapsia tarjoamalla heille pitkäaikaisen kodin, tasapainoisen elinympäristön ja tukemalla heidän kasvuaan ja kehitystään? Sijaisperheenä pääset tekemään todella tärkeää työtä ja vaikuttamaan lapsen elämään kokonaisvaltaisesti. Tällä hetkellä tarvitaan erityisesti sijaisperheitä, joilla on kokemusta vaativista lapsista. Sijaisperhe on perhe, joka antaa kodin lapselle, joka ei voi asua omassa kodissaan. Sijaisperhe huolehtii lapsen arjesta, kasvatuksesta ja hyvinvoinnista. Sijaisperheelle maksetaan palkkiota ja kulukorvausta jokaiselta kuukaudelta, kun sijoitettu lapsi asuu perheessä. Kuukausitulot riippuvat sijoitettujen lasten määrästä (alla olevan taulukon mukaisesti). Tulot kerryttävät eläkettä. -Yksi lapsi: palkkio 2009 euroa, kulukorvaus 1035 euroa, yhteensä 3044 euroa-Kaksi lasta: palkkio 4018 euroa, kulukorvaus 2071 euroa, yhteensä 6089 euroa-Kolme lasta: palkkio 6027 euroa, kulukorvaus 3107 euroa, yhteensä 9134 euroa-Neljä lasta: palkkio 8036 euroa, kulukorvaus 4143 euroa, yhteensä 12179 euroaEnnen kuin voitte toimia sijaisperheenä, tulee teidän osallistua sijaisperhevalmennukseen. Haemme nyt sopivia perheitä tähän yksilöllisesti, eli perhekohtaisesti, toteutettavaan valmennukseemme. Valmennus räätälöidään teille sopivaksi ja sen voi aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan, vaikka heti. jobs.title: Travel Designer bij Nordic - Lofoten & Lapland
jobs.description:
Ben je gebeten door Het Hoge Noorden en kan je die passie gemotiveerd overbrengen?

Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wie zijn wij?

Aangenaam! Wij zijn Nordic: een internationale touroperator waar passie, vakmanschap en werkplezier samenkomen. Elke dag nemen we reizigers én collega’s mee op ontdekking naar onze adembenemende reisbestemmingen: van magische winteravonturen in Lapland tot de ruige schoonheid van de Himalaya.

Bij ons draait het om échte beleving, zowel voor onze reizigers als voor ons team. We geloven in authenticiteit en duurzaamheid, en we steken daar met hart en ziel tijd en zorg in. Wat we doen, doen we met vakmanschap en oog voor detail, zodat elke reis een unieke ervaring wordt.

We moedigen je aan om ondernemend te zijn, nieuwe ideeën aan te brengen en mee te bouwen aan onze groei. Bij Nordic krijg je de vrijheid om initiatief te nemen en eigenaarschap te tonen, om zo mee het verschil te maken.

Onze reizigers staan altijd centraal. Klantgerichtheid zit in alles wat we doen: we luisteren, denken mee en gaan tot het uiterste om dromen waar te maken. En dat doen we met een warm, betrokken team dat elkaar steunt, samen plezier maakt en successen viert: van gezellige afterworks en teambuildings tot inspirerende workations.

Klaar om met ons mee te bouwen aan onvergetelijke reisverhalen?

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je begeleidt klanten en partners van hun eerste reisdroom tot na hun vertrek. Door goed te luisteren naar hun wensen en behoeften vertaal je deze naar persoonlijke, overtuigende en commercieel sterke reisvoorstellen.

  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en je adviseert hen op maat via het kanaal van hun wensen (zij het telefonisch, mail of via afspraak). Dit doe je steeds met het nodige vakmanschap en een gepassioneerde, sympathieke en oprechte houding.
  • Om onze klanten zo goed mogelijk te informeren, geef je ook af en toe infosessies.

jobs.title: SAP Analytics Consultant
jobs.description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer - Deepdesk
jobs.description:
About Deepdesk

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. We use machine learning to provide agents with real-time recommendations and autocomplete suggestions, supporting them in efficiently assisting customers. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We are also building voice agents: AI that talks with customers in real time. Speech is turned into text, a language model works out the answer, and the answer is spoken back, all within a fraction of a second. You will help build and run the services behind this, in Python and Go.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.


What You’ll Be Doing

•  Build and maintain backend services and APIs in Python and Go, with background processing for heavy work.

•  Keep our databases fast and reliable.

•  Run and improve our infrastructure on Google Cloud: Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

•  Build and run the real-time voice agent services: speech to text, language model and text to speech, with low latency, in Python and Go.

•  Help deploy and run the machine learning services behind our recommendations. Machine learning experience is not required.

•  Design and provide complete and accurate end-to-end metrics.

•  Write and review well-tested, clean and maintainable code.

•  Follow software engineering best practices while staying pragmatic and avoiding over-engineering.

•  Contribute to front-end features in TypeScript and React when needed.

Our Stack

•  Backend: Python (Django REST framework, FastAPI and Celery) and Go.

•  Voice: Go for our real-time voice AI service, with WebSockets, speech to text, language models, text to speech and the OpenAI Realtime API.

•  Data: PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse and Elasticsearch.

•  Cloud: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Flux and Cloud Build.

•  Front end: TypeScript and React.

•  Quality: automated tests (pytest, and BDD integration tests written in Go), code review on every change, and automation to keep our code and delivery practices in shape.

What We’re Looking For

•  Strong professional experience building backend services in Python or Go. In Python, Django or FastAPI is a plus.

•  Solid knowledge of relational databases, in particular PostgreSQL.

•  Hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and CI/CD. Google Cloud is a plus.

•  Working knowledge of TypeScript and React, enough to build and fix front-end features. It does not need to be your strength.

•  A disciplined approach to testing, code review, maintainability and delivery.

•  Comfort working with autonomy and taking full ownership in a fast-moving environment.

•  Interest in voice and real-time systems, and willingness to also work in the other language. Our voice AI service and our integration tests are written in Go, and most of the backend is in Python.

•  A plus: experience with Celery, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch, serving machine learning models, or real-time audio.

Why Join Us?

•  Based in the Netherlands, with flexibility over how you organise your time. [HR: confirm office and hybrid details]

•  A small team working with major enterprise clients.

•  Start-up culture combined with enterprise demands and production scale.

•  Full autonomy and full ownership of your work.

•  High standards, trust and plenty of humour.

•  The opportunity to shape real-time AI experiences used in enterprise contact centres.

•  Full-time (40 hours), permanent contract.

Information Security Responsibilities

All employees are responsible for supporting and maintaining the organisation’s information security standards. This includes:

•  Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

•  Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

•  Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

•  Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

•  Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

•  Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in line with company policies and legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

PASSER DU IKKE IND I DE NORMALE KASSER ?Researcher & Faktachecker.Vi søger syvkantede mennesker, der ikke nødvendigvis passer ind i firkantede bokse.Ikke fordi du er unormal. Men fordi dine kompetencer, din personlighed og din måde at arbejde på måske passer bedre til funktioner, som ikke ligner de traditionelle stillinger.Hos MinBy™ er vi ikke specielt optagede af, om du passer ind i en bestemt stillingsbetegnelse.Vi er langt mere interesserede i, hvad du kan, hvad du brænder for, og hvad du kan blive rigtig dygtig til.Måske er du netop den person, vi mangler.

VI ARBEJDER 100 % REMOTE – OG MENER DET!Vi har ingen traditionel arbejdsplads, du skal møde ind på.Vi sidder spredt rundt omkring i hele kongeriget – og enkelte af os arbejder endda fra udlandet.Vi skriver rigtig meget sammen. Vi taler endnu mere sammen.Men vi ses aldrig fysisk – heller ikke via kamera.Det lyder måske usædvanligt. Det er det også.Til gengæld fungerer det for os.

Vi er et lille team, der arbejder tæt sammen, selvom vi sidder vidt forskellige steder.Du arbejder hjemmefra eller fra et andet fast, privat arbejdssted, hvor du har ro og de rigtige arbejdsforhold.Vi forventer, at du møder til tiden, arbejder struktureret, overholder aftaler og normalt afslutter arbejdsdagen til tiden.Du skal ikke bevise dit engagement ved at arbejde døgnet rundt.Du skal bevise det gennem det, du leverer.

MÅSKE ER DU EN AF DEM, VI LEDER EFTER?Du er måske typen, der:

  • Har det bedst med at arbejde hjemmefra og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Er passioneret, nysgerrig og engageret i det, du laver.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret uden en chef, der kigger dig over skulderen.

  • Trives med tæt digital kommunikation og løbende sparring.

  • Har kompetencer, der går på tværs af flere traditionelle jobfunktioner.

  • Gerne vil lære nyt og ikke er bange for AI, automatisering og nye arbejdsmetoder.

  • Sætter pris på stabilitet, fleksibilitet og et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden.

Måske har du tidligere oplevet, at traditionelle arbejdspladser ikke passer særligt godt til dig.Det kan skyldes din bopæl, lang transporttid, familiemæssige forhold eller ganske enkelt, at du arbejder bedst i dine egne omgivelser.For os er det ikke en ulempe. Det kan tværtimod være en fordel.

Vi vil gerne give plads til mennesker, som har både evnerne, lysten og arbejdsmoralen, men som ikke nødvendigvis passer ind i den traditionelle arbejdsmodel.

HVILKEN STILLING SØGER DU EGENTLIG?Det behøver du ikke nødvendigvis vide endnu.Vi har flere forskellige funktioner og arbejdsområder, og vi forventer at udvide teamet med mindst to nye medarbejdere.Du kan også læse vores mere traditionelle stillingsopslag, hvor vi beskriver de enkelte funktioner.Men dette opslag er anderledes.Her søger vi først mennesket og kompetencerne. Derefter finder vi den rigtige funktion.

Måske passer du ind i én af vores eksisterende stillinger.Måske har du en kombination af kompetencer, der gør dig interessant til flere funktioner.Og måske opdager vi sammen en mulighed, vi endnu ikke har defineret.

LØN OG ARBEJDSVILKÅRHvis du kommer forholdsvis ny ind i et arbejdsområde og skal læres op, er vores udgangspunkt en månedsløn på 26.000 kr. efter endt prøvetid ved fuldtidsansættelse.Har du allerede stærke kompetencer, relevant erfaring eller andre lønforventninger, er vi åbne for at drøfte en individuel aftale.Vi foretrækker klart kandidater, der ser vores arbejdsform som en reel fordel – ikke som noget, de blot kan acceptere.

VI ER ET LILLE TEAM MED STORE AMBITIONERMinBy™ udvikler et landsdækkende digitalt medienetværk med 1.522 ultralokale medier.Vi arbejder med journalistik, data, AI, automatisering, digital udvikling, kommunikation og kommercielle løsninger.Vi er ikke en traditionel virksomhed med store afdelinger og lange kommandoveje.Vi udvikler os løbende, og der er kort fra idé til handling.Vi har det også med at blive hængende, når vi først har fundet de rigtige mennesker og er blevet dedikerede til hinanden.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den perfekte ansøgning.Vi søger det rigtige menneske med de rigtige evner og den rigtige indstilling.

VIL DU VIDE MERE OM OS?Vi har samlet vores mere traditionelle stillingsopslag i et digitalt rekrutteringsmagasin.Her kan du læse om vores forskellige arbejdsområder, få et bedre indblik i MinBy™ og se, hvilke muligheder vi tilbyder.

I magasinet kan du også se, hvordan du kommer videre i rekrutteringsprocessen.

ER DU SYVKANTET?Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.Fortæl os gerne, hvad du er rigtig god til, hvad du gerne vil arbejde med, og hvorfor vores måde at arbejde på passer særligt godt til dig.Du behøver ikke presse dig selv ned i en firkantet kasse for at søge hos os.

Det er faktisk hele pointen.

MinBy™ – vi har plads til mennesker, der tænker anderledes.

jobs.title: Morgenfrisk medarbejder til vores biludlejning.
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til en medarbejdere til vores afdelinger i Hørsholm og Birkerød, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i både Birkerød og Hørsolm, og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00. Til gengæld har du tidligt fri.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Embedded Platform
Senior business analyst - deadline 03/11/2026
jobs.description:
Job description :

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst to work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical teams to analyze business needs, define requirements, and ensure successful delivery of features within an Agile/SAFe environment.

The role involves managing the product backlog, preparing and refining user stories, facilitating requirements workshops, supporting PI Planning and sprint execution, and coordinating User Acceptance Testing (UAT). The ideal candidate will have knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power BI, Power Pages, and Dataverse, as well as the ability to leverage AI tools to improve requirements gathering and business process analysis.

Key responsibilities :

  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders, Product Owners, and SMEs to gather, analyze, validate, and document business and technical requirements.

  • Feature & Backlog Management: Analyze upcoming roadmap features, identify business value, dependencies, risks, and gaps, and continuously refine the product backlog.

  • User Stories & Acceptance Criteria: Create and refine Epics, Features, and User Stories with clear scope, detailed acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant functional and non-functional requirements.

  • Business Process Documentation: Prepare process flows (as-is/to-be), mockups, business rules, data mappings, impact assessments, and other supporting documentation as required.

  • Microsoft Power Platform: Understand Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven), Power BI, Power Pages, Dataverse, access structures, data models, solution architecture, and inbound/outbound data flows.

  • Agile & SAFe Delivery: Participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily meetings, system demos, and other Agile/SAFe ceremonies.

  • PI Preparation: Support pre-PI planning activities, identify knowledge gaps and dependencies, prepare refinement materials, and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure feature readiness.

  • Definition of Ready & Definition of Done: Ensure that User Stories meet the agreed Definition of Ready (DoR) before entering a sprint and contain the necessary information to support the Definition of Done (DoD).

  • Technical & Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with development leads, testers, Product Owners, and other teams to clarify technical feasibility, resolve dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope and responsibilities.

  • User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Prepare UAT scenarios, use cases, and sample test data; coordinate end-user testing; collect and analyze feedback; and document decisions and follow-up backlog items.

  • Delivery & Release Support: Verify that delivered functionality meets business requirements, prepare sprint release notes, and ensure that documentation, user guidance, and training materials are updated.

  • Documentation & Traceability: Maintain centralized and accessible project documentation in tools such as SharePoint or Wiki, ensuring traceability from Epics and Features through User Stories, acceptance tests, and releases.

  • AI-Assisted Analysis: Use AI capabilities such as Copilot, AI agents, and other relevant tools to support requirements gathering, process analysis, validation of assumptions, and initial solution ideation.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify business processes, improve requirements quality, and maintain a backlog buffer of approximately 1.5–2 sprints of ready User Stories.


Job requirments:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst in Agile/Scrum and SAFe environments.

  • Strong experience in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, and documentation.

  • Practical knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform, including:

    • Power Apps (Canvas and Model-driven apps)

    • Power BI

    • Power Pages

    • Microsoft Dataverse

    • Data models, access structures, and data integrations.

  • Experience defining and refining Epics, Features, User Stories, and detailed Acceptance Criteria.

  • Knowledge of backlog management, refinement sessions, sprint planning, and PI Planning.

  • Experience with business process modelling, process flows, mockups, business rules, data mappings, and impact assessments.

  • Understanding of functional and non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, availability, security, auditability, and GDPR/privacy.

  • Knowledge of Definition of Ready (DoR), Definition of Done (DoD), and requirements traceability.

  • Experience supporting UAT, including test scenario preparation, test data coordination, feedback analysis, and defect or backlog item management.

  • Ability to identify dependencies, clarify scope, assess gaps, and coordinate with technical teams and business stakeholders.

  • Familiarity with technical documentation, solution architecture, data models, APIs, and integration flows.

  • Experience using documentation and collaboration tools such as SharePoint, Wiki, and backlog management platforms.

  • Awareness of AI tools, including Copilot and AI agents, for requirements analysis, process improvement, and solution ideation.

  • Strong communication, analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple features and priorities in a structured delivery environment.

Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Finom is a fast-growing European tech startup, headquartered in Amsterdam, on a mission to revolutionize the financial landscape for entrepreneurs globally. We are developing an all-in-one financial B2B solution that seamlessly integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a mobile-first platform.
 
Following a significant €115 million Series C equity round, bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million, we are expanding aggressively across key EU markets (Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain). We go beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, to simplify financial management for small and medium-sized businesses.
 
At Finom, we empower our employees to make a real difference. We nurture an innovative and inspiring environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation, and ensuring every effort benefits our users, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Engineering Manager - Product
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager who's both a technical leader and a product builder. You'll guide a cross-functional team (5-10 engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA) in delivering products that create real value for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

What You Will Be Doing
  • You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.
  • You drive predictable delivery by partnering tightly with Product and Design. You communicate proactively about priorities, risks, and constraints. You encourage healthy debate and move toward "disagree and commit" when needed.

    • Who You Are
  • 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust
  • Comfortable with product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, conversion funnels)
  • Exceptional communication in English across all audiencesA builder's mentality: you care about shipping great products and growing great teams

    • Our tech stack

     

  • Backend: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    We're a growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of European businesses. You'll lead a domain team with real ownership and autonomy over what you build and how you build it. This is a place for curious leaders who want to grow as technical managers, product thinkers, and people leaders.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer  (Excavator Automation)
jobs.description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Proficiency in Linux systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

  • Driver’s license B category


    • Beneficial

  • Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

  • Field testing experience

  • Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

  • Experience in motion planning or control

  • Experience in robotic competitions

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
     

    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • About Insify

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

jobs.description:

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) ravnateljica Medicinske škole Karlovac, dr. Andrije Štampara 5, Karlovac, raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

za popunu radnog mjesta

  1. Nastavnik/ica stručnih predmeta (magistar/magistra sestrinstva, stručni/a prvostupnik/prvostupnica (baccalaureus/baccalaurea) sestrinstva), jedan izvršitelj, rad na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme,

VSS/VŠS, visoka stručna sprema, viša stručna sprema

Mjesto rada: Medicinska škola Karlovac, a prema potrebi i izvan sjedišta škole
  1. Uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa:
  • Uz opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, osoba koja zasniva radni odnos u školskoj ustanovi mora ispunjavati uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa određene člankom 105. Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23). U radni odnos ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23).
Uz pisanu prijavu za sudjelovanje u natječaju (vlastoručno potpisanu) potrebno je priložiti:
  1. Životopis,
  2. dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme (preslika diplome o završenom studiju)
  3. dokaz nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 30 dana),
  4. dokaz o evidentiranom radnom stažu (elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje),
  5. dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice ili vojne iskaznice ili putovnice ili domovnice)

Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završetka natječajnog postupka. Kandidat koji bude izabran dužan je dostaviti izvornike traženih isprava prije zaključivanja ugovora o radu.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati te se osobe koje podnesu takve prijave ne smatraju kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj i ne obavještavaju se o razlozima zašto se ne smatraju kandidatima natječaja.

Sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova ( NN br. 82/08. i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe.

Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem posebnih zakonskih propisa dužan je u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i dostaviti propisanu dokumentaciju kojom dokazuje svoju prednost. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na prednost prilikom zapošljavanja temeljem članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br.121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i sve dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br.121/2017., 98/19. i 84/21.), koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja poveznica:bhttps://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13, 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjenju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici na sljedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, te čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune provest će se procjena i vrednovanje znanja i sposobnosti sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Medicinskoj školi Karlovac.

Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj (u nastavku teksta: Povjerenstvo) imenuje ravnateljica Medicinske škole Karlovac na početku školske godine za tu školsku godinu.

Povjerenstvo utvrđuje listu kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune, te kandidate s liste upućuje na procjenu i vrednovanje.

Kandidati su obvezni pristupiti procjeni, ako kandidat ne pristupi utvrđenoj procjeni i vrednovanju , smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za testiranje, bit će objavljeni na mrežnoj stranici Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” istovremeno s objavom natječaja.

Vrijeme, mjesto i način održavanja testiranja objavit će se najmanje tri dana prije dana određenog za testiranje na web stranici Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” s rang listom kandidata koji se pozivaju.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pismenim putem u roku od 15 dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata.

Natječaj je objavljen 02.11.2026.godine na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje, mrežnim stranicama Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” i oglasnoj ploči škole.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno do 10.11.2026. godine.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Medicinskoj školi Karlovac da može prikupljati i obrađivati osobne podatke kandidata iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka ( NN br.42/18)

Prijave dostaviti na adresu: Medicinska škola Karlovac, dr. Andrije Štampara 5, 47000 Karlovac, S naznakom “za natječaj –112-01/26-01/11”

jobs.title: SURADNIK/SURADNICA U ODJELU HOTELSKE PRODAJE – SPECIJALIST ZA OTA KANALE
jobs.description:
Opis poslova:
  • Samostalno upravljanje online prodajom hotelskih smještajnih kapaciteta putem OTA kanala (Booking.com, Expedia i dr.).
  • Kreiranje, ažuriranje i optimizacija prodajnih cijena, raspoloživosti kapaciteta, prodajnih uvjeta i restrikcija.
  • Praćenje tržišnih kretanja, konkurencije, potražnje i dinamike rezervacija te prilagodba prodajne strategije.
  • Upravljanje sadržajem i ponudama na OTA platformama te provođenje promotivnih aktivnosti.
  • Praćenje ključnih pokazatelja uspješnosti prodaje (popunjenost, ADR, RevPAR) i izrada analiza prodajnih rezultata.
  • Rad u hotelskom rezervacijskom sustavu (PMS) i channel manageru te kontrola usklađenosti podataka između prodajnih kanala.
  • Predlaganje i provođenje aktivnosti usmjerenih na povećanje prihoda i optimizaciju prodajnih rezultata.
  • Suradnja s ostalim članovima odjela prodaje i drugim hotelskim odjelima.
Uvjeti:
  • Prethodno radno iskustvo u hotelskoj online prodaji i samostalnom upravljanju OTA kanalima.
  • Aktivno poznavanje rada s platformama Booking.com i Expedia.
  • Iskustvo u upravljanju cijenama, raspoloživošću i prodajnim restrikcijama.
  • Poznavanje rada u hotelskim PMS sustavima i channel managerima.
  • Dobro poznavanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu.
  • Napredno korištenje MS Excela.
  • Izražene analitičke, organizacijske i komunikacijske sposobnosti.
  • Samostalnost, proaktivnost i usmjerenost na ostvarivanje prodajnih rezultata.

Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) ravnateljica Medicinske škole Karlovac, dr. N A T J E Č A J

za popunu radnog mjesta

  1. Nastavnik/ica stručnih predmeta (magistar/magistra sestrinstva, stručni/a prvostupnik/prvostupnica (baccalaureus/baccalaurea) sestrinstva)

,VSS/VŠS, visoka stručna sprema, viša stručna sprema, jedan izvršitelj,

  • rad na neodređeno nepuno radno vrijeme u trajanju od 20 sati tjedno,
  • Mjesto rada: izdvojena lokacija u Gimnaziji i strukovnoj školi Bernardina Frankopana u Ogulinu, a po potrebi i van izdvojene lokacije.
    1. Uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa:
  • Uz opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, osoba koja zasniva radni odnos u školskoj ustanovi mora ispunjavati uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa određene člankom 105. Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23). U radni odnos ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 – RUSRH ,152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23).
  • Uz pisanu prijavu za sudjelovanje u natječaju (vlastoručno potpisanu) potrebno je priložiti:
    1. Životopis,
    2. dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme (preslika diplome o završenom studiju)
    3. dokaz nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 30 dana),
    4. dokaz o evidentiranom radnom stažu (elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje),
    5. dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika osobne iskaznice ili vojne iskaznice ili putovnice ili domovnice)

Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završetka natječajnog postupka. Kandidat koji bude izabran dužan je dostaviti izvornike traženih isprava prije zaključivanja ugovora o radu.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati te se osobe koje podnesu takve prijave ne smatraju kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj i ne obavještavaju se o razlozima zašto se ne smatraju kandidatima natječaja.

Sukladno članku 13. stavku 3. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova ( NN br. 82/08. i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i na ženske osobe.

Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem posebnih zakonskih propisa dužan je u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i dostaviti propisanu dokumentaciju kojom dokazuje svoju prednost. Navedeni kandidati imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na prednost prilikom zapošljavanja temeljem članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br.121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i sve dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN br.121/2017., 98/19. i 84/21.), koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja poveznica:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN br. 157/13, 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjenju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici na sljedećoj poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, te čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune provest će se procjena i vrednovanje znanja i sposobnosti sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Medicinskoj školi Karlovac.

Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj (u nastavku teksta: Povjerenstvo) imenuje ravnateljica Medicinske škole Karlovac na početku školske godine za tu školsku godinu.

Povjerenstvo utvrđuje listu kandidata prijavljenih na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune, te kandidate s liste upućuje na procjenu i vrednovanje.

Kandidati su obvezni pristupiti procjeni, ako kandidat ne pristupi utvrđenoj procjeni i vrednovanju , smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj.

Pravni i drugi izvori za pripremanje kandidata za testiranje, bit će objavljeni na mrežnoj stranici Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” istovremeno s objavom natječaja.

Vrijeme, mjesto i način održavanja testiranja objavit će se najmanje tri dana prije dana određenog za testiranje na web stranici Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” s rang listom kandidata koji se pozivaju.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni pismenim putem u roku od 15 dana od dana donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata.

Natječaj je objavljen 02.11.2026.godine na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje, mrežnim stranicama Medicinske škole Karlovac https://ss-medicinska-ka.skole.hr/ u rubrici pod nazivom “Natječaji” i oglasnoj ploči škole.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno do 10.11.2026. godine.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Medicinskoj školi Karlovac da može prikupljati i obrađivati osobne podatke kandidata iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka ( NN br.42/18)

Prijave dostaviti na adresu:

Medicinska škola Karlovac,

dr. Andrije Štampara 5, 47000 Karlovac,

S naznakom “za natječaj – 112-01/26-01/13”

Uz pisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidati trebaju priložiti: životopis , domovnicu , dokaz o vrsti i stupnju stručne spreme (diplome) , dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu ukoliko su položili , uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak ne stariji od 6 mjeseci (potvrda o nekažnjavanju), vlastoručno napisanu i potpisanu izjavu kandidata da za prijem u službu ne postoji zapreka iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ("Narodne novine" 10/97 107/07,i 94/13) , elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu (ispis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje). 
 
Kandidati koji će se u prijavi pozivati na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti dokaz o ostvarivanju prednosti prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate  pod jednakim uvjetima. 
Svi traženi dokumenti prilažu se u izvorniku ili preslici koja ne treba biti ovjerena, a prije izbora kandidat će predočiti izvornik. 
  
  
Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti kandidati oba spola (čl.13. st. 2 Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova) ( "Narodne novine", broj 82/08 ) 
  
Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja podnose se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje i internetskoj stranici Dječjeg vrtića ,na adresuDječji vrtić "Fijolica" , Gajeva 17 E, 48325 Novigrad Podravski , s naznakom "Natječaj za stručnog suradnika/icu". Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne dostavljene prijave neće se razmatrati. 
  
Dječji vrtić "Fijolica" Novigrad Podravski zadržava pravo, bez obrazloženja, ne prihvatiti ni jednu prijavu, odnosno poništiti natječaj. 
 
Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine br. 42/18) prijavom na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, a koja će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. 
  
Natječajna dokumentacija kandidata koji ne budu prošli će biti trajno uništena nakon isteka 2 mjeseca. 
  
O rezultatima izbora kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 8 dana od dana izbora. 
  
 
Natječaj je objavljen na internetskim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Zavoda za zapošljavanje i Vrtića 02. studenog  2026. godine. 
Natječaj traje do 09. studenog 2026. godine.
