jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
Temeljem čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine broj 10/97, 107/07 ,94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26), Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Osmijeh, objavljuje 30.10.2026.godine N A T J E Č A J za prijem radnika na radno mjesto

  1. ODGOJITELJ/ICA NA NEODREĐENO PUNO RADNO VRIJEME - 1 izvršitelj/ica
- 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno puno radno vrijeme 40 sati tjedno Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih šest mjeseci života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij za Rani i predškolski odgoj propisan Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24 i 62/25) i razine obrazovanja za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti: a) sveučilišni prijediplomski studij, b) stručni prijediplomski studij, c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima, d) sveučilišni diplomski studij, e) stručni diplomski studij,
  • ispunjavanje uvjeta iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  • utvrđena zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz Članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju. Prijava na natječaj (vlastoručno potpisana) treba sadržavati priloge u izvorniku odnosno ovjerenoj preslici i to kako slijedi:

  • Životopis
  • Dokaz o državljanstvu
  • Dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • Potvrdu iz elektroničke baze podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radno pravnom statusu, ne stariju od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
  • Dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 1 i 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 3 i 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
    • potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda sukladno članku 25. st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne stariju od mjesec dana od objave natječaja
  • uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova odgojitelja/ice (prije sklapanja ugovora o radu, odabrani kandidat/i će se uputiti na liječnički pregled radi utvrđivanja zdravstvene sposobnosti)

Ako se na natječaj javi osoba iz članka 24. stavka 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, koja je završila učiteljski studij, prilikom prijave na natječaj dužna je dostaviti dokaz da nije bila zaposlena u sustavu predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na radnom mjestu odgojitelja. U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka EU 2016/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine 42/18). Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Rok za podnošenje prijave kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijava na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom dostavlja se na mail vrtića: djecji.vrtic.osmijeh@zg.t-com.hr Nepotpune, nepravodobne i nepotpisane prijave na natječaj neće se razmatrati. Urednom prijavom će se smatrati pravovremeno prispjele prijave kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja i koje sadržavaju sve tražene podatke i priloge. Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka će se objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Vrtića. Vrtić može poništiti natječaj bez posebnih objašnjenja. Vrtić može donijeti i Odluku o neizboru kandidata. Ovaj Natječaj objavljen je na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a, na web stranici Dječjeg vrtića Osmijeh i oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića dana 30.10.2026 i traje do 07.11.2026. godine.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Ingenieur/in - Chemietechnik)
jobs.description: I tuoi compitiLa risorsa svolgerà le seguenti attività:• elaborazione Heat & Material Balance,• elaborazione Process Flow Diagram per convertire le materie prime in prodotti su specifica,• definizione e dimensionamento di attrezzature e strumentazione ed emissione dei relativi Process Data Sheet,• elaborazione P&ID,• calcoli idraulici e termici su sistemi di tubazioni, in regime stazionario e transitorio,• definizione dei requisiti delle utilities e progettazione dei relativi sistemi,• definizione delle quantità e caratteristiche degli effluenti da smaltire nell'ambiente,• implementazione della filosofia di progettazione contrattuale,• partecipazione alle revisioni di progetti multidisciplinari quali P&ID review, HAZOP, 3D Model review, etc.,• survey in impianto,• scouting fornitori,• preparazione RdO,• allineamenti tecnici,• material requisition.Il tuo profiloRequisiti richiesti:• laurea magistrale in Ingegneria chimica;• almeno 3/4 anni di esperienza;• motivazione e interesse per l’approfondimento degli aspetti tecnici;• buone capacità di lavoro su team di progetto;• buone capacità di coordinamento specialisti esterni;• buona attitudine alle relazioni personali ed alla comunicazione scritta e orale;• disponibilità a viaggiare Italia/estero;• ottima padronanza della lingua italiana. Inglese "fluente” sia parlato che scritto.• Completano il profilo doti di problem solving, dinamicità, capacità di lavorare in team e precisione.Perché noi?• Mensa aziendale• Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa• WelfareChi siamoUnisciti al team di KLK Temix SpA!Da noi troverai una cultura aziendale in cui potrai contribuire attivamente, esprimere le tue idee e partecipare allo sviluppo dell’azienda. Il nostro impegno per la sostenibilità si riflette nei nostri processi e nei nostri prodotti. Onestà, lealtà, apertura e orientamento ai risultati sono i pilastri fondamentali del nostro lavoro quotidiano.Ti offriamo un impiego stabile e orientato al futuro, con numerose opportunità di crescita professionale. Da noi troverai un ambiente di lavoro positivo, in cui il lavoro di squadra e il sostegno reciproco sono valori fondamentali.Entra a far parte di un team motivato e dinamico composto da circa 100 collaboratori nelle sedi di Bologna e Milano, che ogni giorno contribuiscono al successo della nostra azienda.La nostra azienda fa parte del gruppo internazionale Kuala Lumpur Kepong Berhad (KLK), con sede centrale in Malesia. In Europa siamo presenti in sette sedi distribuite tra Svizzera, Belgio, Paesi Bassi, Italia e Germania.KLK Temix SpA appartiene alla divisione aziendale KLK OLEO, uno dei principali operatori globali nel settore dell’industria oleochimica.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People jobs.title: Executive Operations Partner - EPD (Executive Assistant)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our Executive Operations team work closely with Notion’s leadership, serving as trusted advisors, collaborators, and problem-solvers. We focus on amplifying the impact of our executives by anticipating needs, streamlining operations, and building systems that keep leaders focused on the highest leverage work. We’re deeply connected to Notion’s mission and values, and we take pride in creating an environment of collaboration, clarity, and authenticity. Our team thrives on strong relationships, operational excellence, and a shared commitment to building tools that empower people to think and work together more effectively.

This role calls for someone who is proactive, adaptable, and deeply organized. Someone who can balance complex scheduling, drive cross-functional coordination, and bring clarity to fast moving priorities. This person will support 2 leaders in our Engineering and Product orgs. Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, operates independently, and consistently finds ways to improve workflows and communication. You’ll be a key partner in making sure our leaders and the company as a whole can move quickly while staying aligned. 

 

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Organizational support: Partner with Engineering and Product leaders on running the day-to-day of an efficient, high-velocity, and fun organization

 - Calendar management: Prioritize and coordinate the teams’ operating calendar, ensuring time is spent in a way that's most leveraged to achieve our business objectives

 - Meeting aficionado: Organize, attend, and track meeting notes and action items, with an eye on making every interaction productive and warm

 - Travel planner: Flights, hotels, transportation, dining, etc. A strong attention to detail here is valued

 - Expense management: Manages expense reports for the executives you support

 - Culture carrier and community builder: Craft fun & engaging team offsite experiences, celebrate birthdays and anniversaries, new family members, and promotions to ensure employees continue to feel connected and recognized




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of Executive Operations experience at fast-growing companies, ideally with experience with technical teams.

 - Organized and detail-oriented: Strong attention to detail, able to stay calm under pressure, a quick thinker, create order of out chaos

 - Effective communicator: Ability to communicate the priorities of leadership within Notion, whether it is by written, verbal, or group communication

 - Event planning: Experience organizing team events with hundreds of people, as well as multi-day events with smaller groups of people, such as an executive offsite

 - EQ: Love connecting with employees, and have proven ability to build relationships and bring warmth to all levels of the organization

 - Discreet: Demonstrated ability to maintain complete confidentiality on all business matters




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're a Notion evangelist! You love the product, and already use it in your daily life



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $190,000.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: BŪVSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
Sabiedrība ar ierobežotu atbildību "BūvIniciatoR"

juridiskā adrese: Rīga, Krišjāņa Barona iela 82A

aicina darbā

būvstrādniekus darbam būvniecības objektos.

 

Darba pienākumos ietilpst dažādu palīgdarbu veikšana būvobjektā, vienkāršu zemes darbu izpilde, celtniecības materiālu un palīgmateriālu pārvietošana, kā arī būvjavu un betona sastāvu sagatavošana. Darbiniekam būs jāpalīdz būvkonstrukciju uzstādīšanā un demontāžā, jāveic vienkārši mūrēšanas un virsmu sagatavošanas darbi, kā arī jānodrošina būvgružu savākšana un teritorijas sakārtošana.

Darbs paredz arī rokas un vienkāršu elektrisko instrumentu izmantošanu, kā arī pieredzējuša speciālista vadībā vienkāršu nojaukšanas, remonta un apdares darbu veikšanu, tostarp apmetuma labošanas, grīdu pamatņu sagatavošanas, koka konstrukciju izbūves un krāsošanas darbus. Darba pienākumi var ietvert arī citus vienkāršus ēku, dzīvojamo, saimniecības vai ražošanas ēku remonta darbus.

No kandidātiem sagaidām atbildīgu attieksmi pret darbu, spēju strādāt komandā un ievērot darba drošības prasības. 

Uzņēmums piedāvā stabilu darbu un regulāru atalgojumu, nodrošina darbam nepieciešamo aprīkojumu, kā arī sniedz profesionālās izaugsmes iespējas un darbu draudzīgā kolektīvā.

Tööülesanded: - Ettevõtte masinate ja seadmete regulaarne hooldus ning korrashoid;- rikete tuvastamine, diagnostika ja remont; - masinate ja seadmete tehnilise seisukorra regulaarne kontrollimine; - ennetava hoolduse planeerimine ning hooldusplaani koostamine ja järgimine; - hooldus- ja remonditööde dokumenteerimine; - vajalike varuosade ja hooldusmaterjalide vajaduse hindamine ning tellimise korraldamine; - ootamatutele tehnilistele riketele operatiivne reageerimine; - ettepanekute tegemine masinate töökindluse parandamiseks ja rikete ennetamiseks; - masinate ohutu ja nõuetekohase kasutamise jälgimine; - vajadusel koostöö väliste hooldus- ja remondipartneritega.

3D-skannaaja rakennuskohteisiin
jobs.description: **Kiinnostaako sinua 3D-teknologia, digitaalinen aineisto ja käytännön työ erilaisissa kohteissa? Tule mukaan muuttamaan olemassa olevia rakennuksia tarkaksi 3D-aineistoksi. Aikaisempaa kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta tai rakennusalalta ei tarvita. Ratkaisevaa on tekninen uteliaisuus, huolellinen työote ja halu oppia.**_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_Haemme noin **yhdeksää 3D-skannaajaa** määräaikaiseen projektiin 31.12.2026 saakka. Jatko on mahdollinen projektin ja Parmacon työtilanteen mukaan. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja muun skannaustiimin tuen.**Työ sopii hyvin opintojen rinnalle.** Työaika on 0–37,5 tuntia viikossa, ja tarjotuista työvuoroista voi kieltäytyä. Työvuoroista pyritään sopimaan noin 1–2 viikkoa etukäteen. Tuntipalkka on osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan **15,50–17,00 euroa tunnilta**.Työskentelet osana skannaustiimiä ja kierrät työparisi kanssa Parmacon olemassa olevissa rakennuksissa. Suurin osa kohteista sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta kohdekäyntejä on myös eri puolilla Suomea. Työhön voi kuulua ajoittain yöpymisiä. Käynneistä sovitaan joustavasti opiskelutilanteesi ja käytettävyytesi huomioiden.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu:**- rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaus työparin kanssa - skannausaineiston jälkikäsittely ja pistepilvien leikkaaminen - skannausten kattavuuden ja laadun tarkistaminen sekä tarvittavat uusintaskannaukset - kohdetietojen, poikkeamien ja vauriohavaintojen huolellinen dokumentointi - skannauslaitteista huolehtiminen sekä projektin käytännön järjestelyihin ja raportointiin osallistuminen. **Menestyt tehtävässä, kun:**- olet kiinnostunut 3D-teknologiasta, digitaalisista työkaluista ja käytännön tekemisestä - opit mielelläsi uusia laitteita ja ohjelmistoja. Sinun ei tarvitse osata niitä valmiiksi. - työskentelet huolellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti sekä huomaat yksityiskohdat - ratkaiset käytännön ongelmia oma-aloitteisesti ja kysyt tarvittaessa apua - viihdyt liikkuvassa työssä ja työskentelet sujuvasti työparin kanssa - sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti. Omaa autoa ei tarvita. Plussaa, ei edellytys: CAD- tai BIM-ohjelmistot, pistepilvet, 3D-mallinnus tai -skannaus, paikkatieto, data-analyysi, Excel, ohjelmointi, visuaalinen dokumentointi tai muu tekninen tekeminen.**Mitä saat meiltä?**- käytännön kokemusta 3D-skannauksesta ja pistepilviaineistojen käsittelystä - perehdytyksen työssä käytettäviin laitteisiin, ohjelmistoihin ja toimintatapoihin - mahdollisuuden yhdistää liikkuvaa kenttätyötä ja digitaalisen aineiston käsittelyä - kokeneempien asiantuntijoiden ja skannaustiimin tuen - mahdollisuuden kehittää skannausprosessia yhdessä Parmacon asiantuntijoiden kanssa **Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.** Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, valmiuksien ja motivaation perusteella.

jobs.title: Kehittäjä-skannaaja rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaukseen
jobs.description: **Kiinnostaako sinua, mitä tapahtuu, kun rakentaminen, 3D-teknologia ja digitaalinen kehittäminen kohtaavat? Tule mukaan skannaamaan Parmacon olemassa olevia rakennuksia, käsittelemään pistepilviaineistoja ja kehittämään samalla tapoja hyödyntää niistä saatavaa tietoa.**_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_Haemme **kehittäjä-skannaajaa** määräaikaiseen projektiin 31.12.2026 saakka. Jatko on mahdollinen projektin ja Parmacon työtilanteen mukaan. Saat tehtävään perehdytyksen sekä Parmacon asiantuntijoiden ja muun skannaustiimin tuen.**Työ sopii hyvin opintojen rinnalle.** Työaika on 0–37,5 tuntia viikossa, ja tarjotuista työvuoroista voi kieltäytyä. Työvuoroista pyritään sopimaan noin 1–2 viikkoa etukäteen. Tuntipalkka on osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan **17,00–19,00 euroa tunnilta.**Työskentelet osana skannaustiimiä sekä rakennuskohteissa että skannausaineistojen teknisen käsittelyn ja kehittämisen parissa. Suurin osa kohteista sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta kohdekäyntejä on myös eri puolilla Suomea. Käynneistä sovitaan joustavasti opiskelutilanteesi ja käytettävyytesi huomioiden.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu:**- rakennuskohteiden 3D-skannaus yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa - skannausaineistojen käsittely valmiin prosessin mukaisesti, pistepilvien jälkikäsittely ja käsittelyprosessin kehittäminen edelleen - Power Apps -käyttöliittymän rakentaminen skannausaineistojen tarkistamista varten - skannausaineistojen, käsittelyprosessin ja kuvantunnistusratkaisujen testaaminen, laadun varmistaminen ja kehittäminen - aineistojen nimeämisestä, versiohallinnasta ja järjestelmällisestä arkistoinnista huolehtiminen - muun skannaustiimin tekninen tukeminen sekä teknisen dokumentaation ja perehdytyksen kehittäminen. Lisäksi tuot projektista havaintoja ja tietoa Parmacon tekoälyratkaisujen ja portfoliohallinnan tietokannan kehittämisen tueksi. **Tehtävä ei edellytä varsinaista ohjelmointiosaamista.****Menestyt tehtävässä, kun:**- sinulla on opintojen, työkokemuksen tai muun kokemuksen kautta hyvä ymmärrys rakennussuunnittelusta sekä rakennuksista ja rakenteista - olet kiinnostunut tietotekniikasta ja opit nopeasti uusia ohjelmistoja ja digitaalisia työkaluja - työskentelet huolellisesti ja järjestelmällisesti, huomaat yksityiskohdat ja osaat erottaa havainnot oletuksista - tartut uusiin tilanteisiin oma-aloitteisesti, etsit ratkaisuja myös silloin, kun valmista vastausta ei ole, ja viet asiat sinnikkäästi eteenpäin - pystyt viemään kehitysideoita käytäntöön ja työskentelet sujuvasti muun tiimin kanssa - sinulla on voimassa oleva B-ajokortti. Omaa autoa ei tarvita Rakennusalan korkeakouluopinnot ovat tehtävään hyvä pohja. Tehtävä sopii erityisesti rakennustekniikan, rakennussuunnittelun tai arkkitehtuurin opinnoissa pidemmälle edenneelle opiskelijalle. Myös tietotekniikan tai muun teknisen alan tausta voi sopia tehtävään, jos sinulla on lisäksi hyvä ymmärrys rakennuksista, rakenteista tai rakennussuunnittelusta.Plussaa on, jos sinulle ovat jo tuttuja esimerkiksi rakennus- tai rakennesuunnittelu, työmaatyö, tietomallit, pistepilviaineistot, parametrinen suunnittelu, Power Apps tai tekoälyn ja kuvantunnistuksen hyödyntäminen.**Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi.** Jos tehtävä kiinnostaa ja tunnistat itsesi sen tärkeimmistä edellytyksistä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.**Mitä saat meiltä?**- mahdollisuuden yhdistää rakennusalan osaamisen, 3D-teknologian ja digitaalisen kehittämisen - käytännön kokemusta pistepilviaineistoista, tietomalleista, kuvantunnistuksesta ja tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä rakennusalalla - mahdollisuuden kehittää skannausprosessia ja rakentaa konkreettisia digitaalisia ratkaisuja - vastuullisen roolin projektissa, jossa työsi tuloksilla on todellista käyttöä - perehdytyksen sekä Parmacon asiantuntijoiden ja skannaustiimin tuen. Kannustamme erilaisista taustoista tulevia osaajia hakemaan. Arvioimme hakijat tehtävän kannalta olennaisen osaamisen, valmiuksien ja motivaation perusteella.

jobs.title: AWS Cloud Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
As a Senior AWS Cloud Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead on our most complex engagements, from assessment and mobilization to large-scale migration and modernization. You will report to an Engineering Manager based in Europe and lead distributed teams of US- and Budapest-based engineers. You will also work closely with colleagues in our AI/ML and Application Development practices.



What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the technical delivery of complex, high-impact migration and modernization engagements, including AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) assessments and mobilization.

  • Lead technical discovery and design multi-service, cloud-native AWS architectures that turn business goals into scalable blueprints.

  • Technically lead teams of 1â4 engineers, and manage the technical roadmap of 2â3 engagements in parallel.

  • Own technical design decisions within project scope. Resolve technical disagreements and handle scope conversations with clients professionally.

  • Represent Client in customers sessions, including executive-level conversations and joint sessions with AWS stakeholders.

  • Spend around 25% of your time on pre-sales: discovery, solution design and co-selling with AWS account teams in North America.

  • Resolve high-risk technical blockers and escalations, including critical production incidents.

  • Adapt to changing delivery expectations and keep engagements on track under uncertainty.

  • Build architectural guardrails, reusable frameworks and components that raise quality across the practice.

  • Coach engineers and share knowledge through internal sessions, workshops, whitepapers and technical evangelism.

  • Be the go-to expert in one or more domains, such as MSSQL Server, PostgreSQL, EKS, VMware, data, security or networking.

  • Help shape our technical offerings and accelerators in line with market and AWS trends.



What you bring:

  • 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and delivering on AWS.

  • A proven track record of leading at least two large-scale cloud migrations end to end.

  • Hands-on database migration experience with MSSQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL.

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect â Professional.

  • In-depth knowledge of core AWS services, including:

    • Compute and containers: EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS

    • Storage and databases: S3, RDS, EFS, EBS

    • Networking and integration: VPC, API Gateway, CloudFront, SNS, SQS

    • Security: IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, KMS, AWS Private CA

    • Operations and migration: CloudWatch, AWS Application Migration Service

jobs.title: Marketing Koordinator til MyCruise (barselsvikariat)
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret, initiativrig og god til at holde mange bolde i luften? 

Brænder du for marketing, og trives du med at skabe overblik, koordinere kampagner og få mennesker til at arbejde godt sammen? 

Hos MyCruise søger vi en Marketing Koordinator til vores marketingteam på hovedkontoret i Vanløse. 

Stillingen er et 9-måneders barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. 

Som Marketing Koordinator får du en central rolle i at koordinere vores marketingaktiviteter på tværs af Danmark, Norge, Sverige og UK. 

Du bliver bindeleddet mellem vores kampagneansvarlige, lokale salgsteams og specialister inden for blandt andet paid media, sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, grafisk produktion og e-commerce. 

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og sørge for, at vores kampagner og marketingaktiviteter bliver gennemført til tiden og i høj kvalitet. 

Du bliver en del af et marketingteam med mange forskellige opgaver, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, hjælper hinanden og har plads til både gode idéer og godt humør. 

Om jobbet 

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at vores marketingkampagner hænger sammen på tværs af kanaler og markeder. 

Du kommer blandt andet til at: 

  • Koordinere marketingkampagner på tværs af teams, kanaler og samarbejdspartnere. 

  • Omsætte kampagnebriefs til konkrete opgaver og holde styr på deadlines, materialer og leverancer. 

  • Sikre tæt dialog mellem marketing og de lokale salgsteams om behov og kampagner. 

  • Koordinere versionering, oversættelser og lokal tilpasning af nyhedsbreve og øvrigt marketingmateriale. 

  • Assistere med tekstforfatning, korrektur, nyhedsbreve og lettere indholdsopgaver. 

  • Koordinere indhold og materialer til websites, sociale medier og annoncering. 

  • Hjælpe med dokumentation og afrapportering af partnerkampagner. 

  • Indsamle kampagneresultater og bidrage til evaluering og forbedring af kommende aktiviteter. 

  • Bidrage med idéer og praktisk hjælp til øvrige marketingaktiviteter efter behov. 

Du får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige koordinering, men arbejder tæt sammen med vores kampagneansvarlige om prioriteringer, budgetter og timing. 

Du skal ikke kunne producere alt selv. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, følge op og sikre, at de rette mennesker har, hvad de skal bruge for at komme i mål. 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har en god forståelse for marketing, er naturligt struktureret og trives med en hverdag, hvor der sker mange ting.  

  • Gerne har 2-3 års erfaring fra en koordinatorrolle i en marketingafdeling, et digitalt bureau, reklamebureau eller lignende. 

  • Har en relevant uddannelse inden for marketing, kommunikation eller tilsvarende. 

  • Har en god forståelse for digital marketing, herunder sociale medier, nyhedsbreve, annoncering og websites. 

  • Har erfaring med eller kendskab til projektstyringsværktøjer som Asana, Monday.com eller lignende. 

  • Har gode skriftlige kommunikationsevner og flair for kommercielt indhold. 

  • Er struktureret, detaljeorienteret og god til at følge op på opgaver og deadlines. 

  • Er proaktiv, har ben i næsen og tør stille spørgsmål og udfordre kolleger konstruktivt. 

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt, og flere opgaver skal løses samtidig. 

Har du erfaring fra rejsebranchen, arbejdet med marketing på tværs af flere lande eller kendskab til Klaviyo, CMS eller Canva, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav. 

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, tager initiativ og motiveres af at skabe struktur og gode resultater sammen med andre. 

Hvem er MyCruise? 

MyCruise er et af Skandinaviens førende specialiserede krydstogtsrejsebureauer. Vi samarbejder med en lang række af verdens største krydstogtsrederier og hjælper hvert år vores kunder med at finde den helt rigtige rejse. 

Vi sælger både klassiske ocean cruises, Exclusive cruises og River cruises. 

Vi har kontorer i Danmark, Norge, Sverige og Storbritannien, mens vores danske hovedkontor ligger i Vanløse. Her arbejder marketing tæt sammen med blandt andet salg, produkt og e-commerce om at inspirere vores kunder og skabe gode rejseoplevelser. 

Vi er i vækst og har store ambitioner for de kommende år. Derfor leder vi efter mennesker, der har lyst til at udvikle sig sammen med os. 

Hvad tilbyder vi? 

  • En spændende og alsidig marketingrolle med mulighed for at gøre en forskel. 

  • Tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger på tværs af vores fire markeder. 

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling. 

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med marketing i en branche, hvor vi sælger oplevelser og rejser. 

  • Personalepriser på rejser. 

  • Pension og sundhedsordning. 

  • Frokostordning, frugt, kaffe og sodavand. 

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger. 

  • En organisation med korte beslutningsveje og plads til nye idéer. 

  • Arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor i Vanløse tæt på metro og S-tog. 

Lyder det som dig? 

Send dit CV og din ansøgning til job@mycruise.dk 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat. 

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat på 9 måneder med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt, og arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vanløse.

jobs.title: Arbeidsleder - Stillas bransjen
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter en arbeidsleder som kan lede vårt team og sikre effektiv og sikker gjennomføring av prosjektene våre. Vi er en ledende aktør innen stillas bygging, og vi søker en dyktig arbeidende formann for å styrke vårt team i Møre og Romsdal. Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe på spennende prosjekter, samtidig som du leder et kompetent team.

Hva vi ser etter

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Ansvarsfull og selvstendig.

  • Gode organisatoriske ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å motivere og veilede teammedlemmer.

  • Løsningsorientert og trygg i utfordrende situasjoner.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Lede og organisere stillasbygging på byggeplasser.

  • Sikre at prosjektene gjennomføres i henhold til sikkerhetskrav og forskrifter.

  • Koordinere arbeidsteamet og sørge for effektiv ressursbruk.

  • Utføre risikovurdering og sørge for sikkerheten på byggeplassen.

  • Kommunisere med prosjektledelse og kunder.

  • Delta aktivt i det praktiske stillasarbeidet.

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Må ha godkjent sertifisering i stillasarbeid enten med fagbrev eller som godkjent stillasmontører etter § 17-4.

  • Minimum 5 års erfaring som arbeidende formann eller i relevant rolle.

  • Gode lederegenskaper og erfaring med teamledelse.

  • God forståelse for sikkerhet og risikovurdering.

  • Førerkort for bil (fordel med BE og CE) og gjerne truckførerbevis.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

  • Konkurransedyktig lønn.

  • Gode arbeidsforhold i et støttende arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheter for faglig utvikling og videreutdanning.

  • Fast ansettelse med forsikringsordninger og pensjonsavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Fjord Stillas As er et selskap som driver med utleie og montering av stillas, samt opplæring innenfor stillas faget. Fjord Stillas As henvender seg i all hovedsak mot proffmarkedet. Vi har hatt en stor del av vår virksomhet rettet mot privat og forskjellige industrier, hvor vi har stillas ansvar for prosjektledelse, montering og stillas utstyr. Vi har også mye aktivitet mot bygg og anleggsbransjen. Utleie parken består av fasade og spirstillas i aluminium, som vi monterer og leier ut over hele Møre og Romsdal. Fjord Stillas As har 8 egne montører og leier inn ekstra montører ved behov.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen


Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

Wulff Works Etelä Oy

Meidän työntekijämme viihtyvät parhaiten asiakkaillamme! 


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

jobs.title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the TFS product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our TFS ALD equipment, which is used by universities, research institutes and corporate R&D labs around the world. This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs TFS ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in TFS and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 19.11. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Jan-Erik Kari, Engineering Manager 0407618584, Fridays 6th and 13th 10.00-11.00.Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.description: Haemme nyt Helsinkiin vuokravälittäjää. Meiltä löytyy runsaasti toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä. Toivomme, että osaat ja haluat hyödyntää digitaalisia työkaluja, järjestelmiä ja sosiaalista mediaa.Rennossa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössämme on helppo viihtyä, ja työkavereilta saa aina apua tarvittaessa. Tarjoamme joustavan työajan ja kannustavan provisiopalkkauksen. Korvaamme myös oman auton käytöstä syntyvät kilometrit. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.**Dina arbetsuppgifter**Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.**Kvalifikationskrav**Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med servering. Du behöver kunna svenska och engelska. Finska är mycket meriterande. Erfarenhet av ansvarsfull alkoholservering och giltigt alkopass/serveringspass krävs.**Varaktighet**Tjänsten är på hel- eller deltid hos oss på Park Restaurang & Bar. Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.**Lön**Lön enligt överenskommelse.Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com! jobs.title: Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, ABB Oy Motion Service
jobs.description: [https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/dbcc5f1a-58b3-437a-9531-571cb56c77a9/original.png]Do you want to play a key role in shaping learning and capability development in a truly global environment? We are looking for a Learning & Digital Training Coordinator to join ABB's international Learning & Digital Training team. In this role, you will support the coordination and delivery of learning programs, digital training solutions, and learning platforms while collaborating with stakeholders across a global organization.About the RoleAs a Learning & Digital Training Coordinator, you will play an important role in supporting and coordinating global learning and training initiatives within the Motion Global Capability Team of Motion Service organization. Working closely with internal teams, global stakeholders, and external partners, you will help track agreed actions, follow up with stakeholders, and keep learning content and documentation up to date.You will support the use of digital learning tools, including eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate, and assist with routine Learning Management System (LMS) activities under team guidance. Your work will help maintain a consistent, user-friendly learning experience and contribute to continuous improvement of the teams processes and tools.This position offers an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in digital learning platforms, training operations, and global collaboration rather than independent ownership of learning content, platforms, or content strategy.Key ResponsibilitiesKey responsibilities include: * Supporting the coordination of learning and training activities across the Motion Service organization * Assisting with meeting organization KPIs, action tracking, and stakeholder follow-up· Support the use of digital learning tools, including eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate, and assist with routine LMS activities under team guidance * Updating and maintaining learning content and related documentation * Supporting communication with internal teams and external partners involved in training activities * Maintaining structured documentation of ongoing tasks, actions, and projects * Contributing to the continuous improvement of learning processes, tools, and ways of workingThis role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in digital learning, training coordination, and international collaboration while supporting a global organization's learning and development initiatives.What We Are Looking ForYou may be at the beginning of your career or already have a few years of professional experience. What matters most is your interest in digital learning solutions, willingness to learn, and understanding of how effective learning experiences are built.We hope you bring:· An interest in learning, development, and digital training environments· Confidence in using common digital workplace tools and platforms· Strong communication and coordination skills when working with different stakeholders· A structured and well-organized approach to managing tasks and priorities· The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others· A proactive, flexible, and solution-oriented mindset, with curiosity and a willingness to learn and take initiative· Fluent English skills, as English is the daily working language and the official language used across the organization in this roleWhat Makes You Successful in This RoleYou thrive in collaborative and international environments and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders. You are motivated by improving learning experiences and supporting digital training initiatives that make a real impact across a global organization. With a proactive mindset and eagerness to learn, you apply best practices, work effectively within established processes, and contribute to an inclusive, safe, and supportive team culture.What We OffersABB is a global technology company where you will become part of an international yet close-knit team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your expertise in learning and training while building a long-term career within a global organization.The position is a fixed-term assignment of one year, with a preferred start date as soon as possible. This position will be offered as a temporary agency assignment through Adecco Finland. The collective agreement is for senior salaried employees in the technology industryThe role offers full remote flexibility. jobs.title: Ohjaaja
jobs.description: Osa-aikainen nuorten ryhmänohjaaja – Kotka**Sosiaalipalvelut Elämän Avaimet Oy** hakee osa-aikaista ryhmänohjaajaa nuorten toiminnalliseen ryhmätoimintaan Kotkaan.Olemme pieni sosiaalialan yritys, jonka toiminnassa korostuvat nuorten aito kohtaaminen, luottamuksellisuus, yhdessä tekeminen ja yksilöllinen tuki.TyötehtäväTehtävässä vastaat pääsääntöisesti itsenäisesti noin kuuden 12–15-vuotiaan nuoren ryhmän käytännön ohjaamisesta.Ryhmätoiminta on valmiiksi suunniteltua, mutta pääset vaikuttamaan käytännön toteutukseen ja tuomaan mukaan omia vahvuuksiasi.Toiminta on rentoa, osallistavaa ja käytännönläheistä. Siihen voi sisältyä esimerkiksi biljardia, erilaisia pelejä, liikuntaa, retkiä ja muuta yhdessä tekemistä. Tavoitteena on tukea nuorten sosiaalisia taitoja, osallisuutta ja mielekästä vapaa-aikaa.Työhön sisältyy nuorten kuljetuksia yrityksen autolla, toiminnan valmistelua sekä sovittuja kirjauksia ja raportointia.Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta yrityksen vastuuhenkilöt ovat tarvittaessa nopeasti tavoitettavissa ja tukevat toimintaasi.Työaika ja työsuhde- Osa-aikainen työ, alustavasti noin 5–8 tuntia viikossa. - Työskentely pääasiassa keskiviikkoisin klo 14.30–21.00 välisenä aikana. - Toimintaan voi sisältyä erikseen sovittavia retkiä ja tapahtumia myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin. - Työajan lisääntyminen on mahdollista uusien ryhmien käynnistyessä. - Työsuhde on alustavasti noin kuuden kuukauden määräaikainen. - Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Odotamme sinulta- Soveltuvaa sosiaali-, terveys- tai kasvatusalan koulutusta, ensisijaisesti sosionomi (AMK) tai vastaavaa osaamista. - Kokemusta nuorten kanssa työskentelystä. - Itsenäistä ja vastuullista työotetta. - Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja kykyä kohdata erilaisia nuoria. - B-ajokorttia ja valmiutta kuljettaa nuoria yrityksen autolla. Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta nuorten ryhmätoiminnasta, neuropsykiatristen erityispiirteiden huomioimisesta sekä toiminnallisista ohjausmenetelmistä.Tarjoamme- Monipuolisen ja itsenäisen työn nuorten parissa. - Valmiiksi suunnitellun ryhmätoiminnan ja perehdytyksen tehtävään. - Pienen yrityksen joustavan ja helposti tavoitettavan työyhteisön. - Tarvittavat työvälineet sekä yrityksen auton työtehtäviin. - Mahdollisuuden työmäärän lisääntymiseen uusien ryhmien käynnistyessä. **Palkkaus:** Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukainen. Palkassa huomioidaan tehtävän vaativuus, koulutus ja aikaisempi kokemus. Palkasta voidaan neuvotella.Tehtävään valittavan henkilön soveltuvuus ja kelpoisuus tarkistetaan. Lasten kanssa työskentelyyn liittyvä rikosrekisteriote tarkistetaan soveltuvan lainsäädännön mukaisesti.HakuohjeetLähetä lyhyt hakemus ja CV sekä kerro kokemuksestasi nuorten kanssa työskentelystä ja mahdollisuudestasi työskennellä keskiviikkoisin.**Hakemukset ja lisätiedot:**Ilkka.huovila@elamanavaimetoy.fiTii.huovila@elamanavaimetoy.fi**Verkkosivut:** https://elamanavaimetoy.fi**Hakuaika:** 15.11.2026 asti.Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja voimme kutsua sopivia hakijoita haastatteluun ennen hakuajan päättymistä.

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing Department of Food Science Faculty of Science University of Copenhagen The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative. The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:
  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:
  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties. The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact. Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered. Associate professor Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required. The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department. Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered. University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement. Please read more here For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here The tenure-track assistant programme The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures. Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields. After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen. Salary and employment conditions The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff. Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk). Filing of application The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below). The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include
  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 3 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1. After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/. Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027. Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. 211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description: ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOONKotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 30 eri puolilla Suomea. jobs.title: Senior ERP Transformation Lead - IFS Cloud
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking a highly experienced Senior ERP Transformation Lead to lead a large-scale business and ERP modernization initiative for a major Nordic enterprise.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

This is a high-impact leadership assignment with direct exposure to executive stakeholders and responsibility for driving a complex transformation from legacy IFS environments to IFS Cloud. The role goes far beyond traditional project management and requires someone who can effectively lead change, influence senior decisionmakers, and build alignment across both business and technology organizations.

Youll take ownership of a strategic transformation program covering several core business functions, including:
 Finance
 Human Resources
 Procurement & Supplier Management
 Enterprise-wide business processes and supporting platforms

The objective is not only to modernize the ERP landscape, but also to transform business processes, governance models, and ways of working across multiple countries and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities:
 Lead a complex ERP transformation program end-to-end
 Drive migration from legacy IFS to IFS Cloud
 Act as the bridge between business and technology teams
 Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-level executives
 Establish governance, alignment, and decision-making across the organization
 Lead change management and business transformation activities

Requirements:
 Proven experience leading large-scale ERP transformation programs
Strong IFS / IFS Cloud transformation experience
 Background in business transformation and organizational change
 Experience working directly with executive stakeholders
 Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
 Experience in multinational and complex business environments

Ideal Profile:
You are a senior transformation leader who combines ERP expertise with strong executive presence and the ability to build alignment, challenge stakeholders, and drive change across business and IT functions.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Have you led an ERP transformation involving IFS or IFS Cloud?*
- Have you worked directly with CIO, CFO, or other C-level stakeholders?*
- Have you led business transformation alongside technology implementation?*
- Have you managed stakeholders across multiple countries or business units?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Start: ASAP
Location: Finland
Allocation: Full-time 100 %
Duration: 14-18 months initially, with potential extension
Languages: English required, Finnish preferred

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application!
